Ahead of the Amazon Great Indian Festival, which begins on October 8, customers using Amazon Now will have access to deals across multiple product categories. Amazon will also offer a 10 percent instant discount on SBI Credit Cards, Debit Cards, and EMI transactions, while Prime members will be eligible for additional savings on select purchases.
Acerpure India, a part of the Acer Group, has introduced its new Nitro QLED TV range in India. The smart TV lineup is now available on Flipkart and includes 75-inch, 85-inch, and 100-inch screen variants, targeting consumers seeking large-screen home entertainment and gaming experiences.
The new Nitro QLED TVs combine QLED display technology with a 120Hz HSR refresh rate, aimed at delivering smoother visuals for gaming, sports broadcasts, and high-motion content. The televisions also support Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos, offering enhanced picture quality and audio performance. The range runs on Google TV 5.0 Ref+, providing access to streaming platforms, smart TV features, and connected entertainment services.
In terms of audio, the 75-inch and 85-inch models come equipped with 40W box speakers, while the 100-inch variant features a 65W box speaker system. The televisions also include a built-in karaoke feature, expanding their entertainment offering for family and group viewing.
Vasudeva G, Director, Acerpure India said, “The way consumers experience entertainment at home is evolving rapidly, and we see a growing desire for experiences that are not just bigger, but genuinely more immersive and engaging. With Nitro, we are bringing the scale of the big screen into the living room and creating a proposition that is as much about the experience as it is about the technology behind it. The 75-inch, 85-inch, and 100-inch formats reflect our ambition to make larger-than-life entertainment more accessible to Indian consumers. Our association with Akshay Kumar as the brand ambassador for Acerpure further strengthens this vision of connecting technology with contemporary lifestyles and entertainment. Through our partnership with Flipkart, we are excited to take this proposition to consumers across the country.”
The launch comes as demand for premium smart TVs, large-screen displays, connected home entertainment devices, and gaming-focused televisions continues to grow in India. With larger display options and advanced audio-visual features, Acerpure is expanding its presence in the consumer electronics and smart TV market. The Acerpure Nitro QLED TV range is available on Flipkart, with prices starting at Rs 59,999.
ICA-GemLab, an international organisation specialising in diamonds, coloured gemstones, and jewellery testing, is set to open its first laboratory in India this October. The new facility will be located in Surat, Gujarat, a major global hub for diamond processing, jewellery manufacturing, and gemstone trade. The laboratory will offer testing, certification, and reporting services for diamonds, coloured gemstones, and jewellery, providing manufacturers, traders, retailers, jewellery brands, and consumers with access to gemological analysis within India.
The Surat facility marks ICA-GemLab’s first laboratory in the Indian subcontinent and forms part of the organisation’s expansion strategy to strengthen its presence in key global gems and jewellery sourcing markets. The laboratory will operate in coordination with ICA-GemLab’s headquarters in Bangkok and its existing offices in Dubai and Hong Kong.
As one of the world's leading centres for diamond cutting, polishing, and jewellery production, Surat plays a critical role in the global gems and jewellery supply chain. The new laboratory aims to provide testing and reporting services closer to the manufacturing and trading stages before products enter retail channels. ICA-GemLab is affiliated with the International Colored Gemstone Association (ICA), a global trade body representing the coloured gemstone industry. The Surat laboratory will follow the reporting standards, analytical procedures, and professional practices adopted across the ICA-GemLab network.
Kalpesh Desai, who will lead ICA-GemLab India as Director said, “India has a significant share of the world’s diamond processing, with Surat being one of its key centres. Our aim is to provide direct access to our internationally established analytical methods and reporting standards to manufacturers, traders, retailers, designers and consumers. We are working with a long-term plan. We aim to provide reliable gemological information, documented methodologies and analysis that can help traders and consumers make decisions based on appropriate information.”
Amira Hatta, Managing Director, ICA-GemLab Global said, “India is one of the most important markets in the global gems and jewellery industry. Opening a laboratory in Surat will bring our analytical capabilities directly to this market, so that customers will have access to our services closer to where they operate.”
The laboratory will issue three categories of reports: Diamond Reports, Coloured Gemstone Reports, and Jewellery Reports. These services will cater to jewellery manufacturers, wholesalers, gemstone traders, retailers, jewellery designers, industry professionals, and end consumers.
Headquartered in Bangkok, ICA-GemLab currently operates offices in Dubai and Hong Kong. The organisation also works with Sri Lanka’s National Gem and Jewellery Authority to provide gem testing services in the country. The launch of the Surat laboratory represents the latest step in its international expansion within the gems, diamonds, and jewellery certification sector.
ITC Ltd has acquired the remaining 52.5 percent stake in Sproutlife Foods Private Ltd for approximately Rs 645 crore, taking full ownership of the health foods company and making it a wholly owned subsidiary. According to a regulatory filing, the FMCG major purchased 13,445 equity shares of Sproutlife Foods through a secondary cash transaction. Following the acquisition, ITC's shareholding in the company has increased from around 47.5 percent to 100 percent.
The transaction was completed on September 28, and Sproutlife Foods became a wholly owned subsidiary of ITC with effect from the same date. The company stated that no regulatory approvals were required for the acquisition. The move is aligned with ITC's strategy to strengthen its presence in the packaged foods, health foods, nutrition products, and FMCG segments while expanding its future-ready food portfolio.
Sproutlife Foods owns and markets products under the Yoga Bar brand, which operates in the healthy snacks, breakfast cereals, protein products, and nutrition-focused food categories. Founded in February 2015, the company has reported steady growth over the past three financial years.
The company recorded a turnover of Rs 452 crore in FY2025-26, up from Rs 200 crore in FY2024-25 and Rs 108 crore in FY2023-24, reflecting strong growth in India's health and wellness food market. The acquisition further strengthens ITC's position in the fast-growing health foods and packaged nutrition category, where consumer demand for better-for-you food products continues to rise.
Pepperfry has entered into a strategic partnership with Imaginest, a home interiors and modular solutions company promoted by the founders of Capstone Life, to strengthen its presence in the modular furniture and home interiors segment. The collaboration will combine Imaginest's design, manufacturing, and project execution capabilities with Pepperfry's omnichannel retail network, consumer reach, and home category expertise. The companies aim to offer customers an integrated experience covering design, customization, manufacturing, delivery, installation, and after-sales support.
The partnership is intended to simplify the home interiors journey by addressing common challenges such as dealing with multiple vendors, pricing transparency, and project execution timelines. Through the association, customers will be able to access modular home solutions through selected Pepperfry store locations.
Umesh Sangurmath, Founder, Capstone Life said, "The home interiors journey continues to be fragmented, particularly as customers look for reliable partners who can manage the journey from design to execution. Imaginest was created to bring thoughtful design and quality execution together. Our partnership with Pepperfry allows us to bring this proposition to customers in key markets, combining our capabilities with Pepperfry’s strong consumer presence and making the process of creating a home simpler and more predictable."
Balavender Singh, CEO, Imaginest added, "Our partnership with Pepperfry is about creating a better modular home experience for customers in major markets. By combining Imaginest’s design and execution capabilities with Pepperfry’s consumer connect and Store ecosystem, we can bring greater transparency, accountability and speed to the journey from the first design conversation through to installation and after-sales support. Together, we see an opportunity to build a differentiated modular proposition in the markets that matter most to today’s urban homeowner."
Ashish Shah, Co-Founder and CEO, Pepperfry said, "Modular furniture and home interiors are important growth areas for Pepperfry. Partnering with Imaginest strengthens our design and execution capabilities and enables us to deliver a more integrated modular experience to customers in key markets. Together, we aim to combine greater choice and transparent pricing with dependable execution and long-term product support."
The rollout will initially cover selected Pepperfry stores in major cities and key markets, with plans to expand the partnership's footprint over time. The collaboration comes as demand for modular kitchens, wardrobes, storage solutions, and customized home interiors continues to grow in India's home improvement and furniture retail market. Industry players are increasingly focusing on end-to-end solutions that combine design expertise, execution capabilities, and omnichannel customer engagement.
Flipkart has announced a major expansion of its supply chain and logistics infrastructure ahead of The Big Billion Days and the upcoming festive shopping season. Through its logistics arm Ekart, the company has added 14 million cubic feet of warehousing space across India, increasing its storage capacity by 50 percent. The e-commerce company said technology and automation upgrades have also increased peak processing capacity by more than 30 percent, enabling faster order fulfilment and delivery during the high-demand festive period.
To strengthen last-mile delivery capabilities, Ekart has added more than 900 delivery hubs across the country. The expansion is aimed at increasing same-day and next-day deliveries as online shopping demand rises during the festive season. With these additions, Ekart's network now includes more than 8,200 facilities, comprising fulfilment centres, sortation hubs, and last-mile delivery operations. The company also operates nearly 1,200 Flipkart Minutes micro-fulfilment centres across more than 150 cities.
As part of its efforts to support MSMEs, small businesses, artisans, weavers, and marketplace sellers, Flipkart has pre-positioned more than 2.5 crore product units in Ekart fulfilment centres ahead of the festive sale. The company has also opened 70 additional pick-up stations in key seller clusters to reduce fulfilment timelines and improve inventory movement.
Ekart's third-party logistics (3PL) franchise network has grown to 600 locations within two months of launch, enabling businesses beyond the Flipkart marketplace to access logistics and delivery services during the festive season. The company has also expanded its delivery footprint by adding more than 750 new PIN codes. The expansion includes regions such as Leh in Ladakh, Kargil in Jammu and Kashmir, parts of Rajasthan and Madhya Pradesh, and several locations across the Northeast, including Kamalanagar and Zamuang in Mizoram, Turacity, Resubelpara and Rajabala in Meghalaya, and Bomdila and Tezu in Arunachal Pradesh.
Hemant Badri, Senior Vice President and Head, Supply Chain, Flipkart Group said, "Every year, The Big Billion Days raises the bar for what customers expect: faster deliveries and wider reach. This year, a customer in Leh or Kargil will experience Big Billion Days for the first time. Across Ekart and Flipkart Minutes, we now operate over 8,200 facilities, allowing us to take the festive experience to more customers while helping sellers reach buyers they could not reach before."
To support increased operational demand, Flipkart has announced the creation of more than 2.5 lakh direct and indirect employment opportunities during the festive season. Of these, nearly 75,000 roles are expected to be filled by first-time workforce entrants. Around 60 percent of the new opportunities will be focused on last-mile delivery operations, reflecting the company's emphasis on faster deliveries and the continued expansion of Flipkart Minutes across Tier ll and Tier lll cities.
The company also highlighted measures for delivery personnel, known as Wishmasters. These include term life insurance, personal accident coverage, mediclaim benefits, access to a Doctor on Call service, festive-season bonuses, referral incentives, and AI-enabled onboarding through the Flipkart Delivery Partners app. The expansion underscores Flipkart's focus on strengthening its e-commerce logistics network, supply chain capabilities, seller ecosystem, and quick commerce operations ahead of one of India's largest online shopping events.
The Adie Broswon Group has entered the whisky segment with the launch of Kingpin Whisky, expanding its spirits portfolio across Delhi, Punjab and Chandigarh. The launch comes as India’s whisky market continues to record growth, with brands increasingly catering to consumers across different price points and consumption occasions.
According to IWSR data cited by the company, India recorded 4 percent growth in beverage alcohol volumes in 2025, while Indian whisky volumes also increased by 4 percent during the year. Against this backdrop, Kingpin has been introduced with a focus on combining a distinctive whisky profile with accessible pricing.
Kingpin is made using a blend of malts and Indian grain spirits. The product is designed to combine the character of malt whisky with the smoothness and versatility associated with grain spirits.
The whisky undergoes maturation and filtration, with the resulting profile featuring smoky notes alongside hints of tobacco and honey. The company said the product has been developed to offer a balanced drinking experience while retaining a pronounced character.
The brand is positioned around the philosophy “Live Bold. Drink Bold.” Its packaging uses a royal blue and gold colour scheme, with a crown-inspired insignia forming part of the visual identity.
Kingpin is being introduced in seven pack sizes: 1,000 ml, 750 ml, 500 ml, 375 ml, 180 ml, 90 ml and 60 ml. The range is intended to address different consumption occasions and price points across its initial markets.
The 750 ml bottle is priced at Rs 500 in Delhi, Rs 530 in Chandigarh and Rs 750 in Punjab. The varied pricing reflects differences across state markets, where alcoholic beverage taxation and pricing structures can vary.
The launch is part of the Adie Broswon Group’s broader focus on developing its own alcoholic beverage brands alongside its existing brewing and distillation operations.
Headquartered in Delhi NCR, the Group has interests across sugar, brewing, distillation and renewable energy. Its integrated 170-acre agro-industrial complex in Kiri Afgana, Batala, includes a sugar mill, three distilleries and a brewery.
The facility is supported by more than 6,000 professionals, according to the company. The Group operates under the philosophy “Victory in Every Field” and continues to expand its presence across its businesses under the leadership of Mrs. Jasdeep Kaur Chadha.
With its initial launch across Delhi, Punjab and Chandigarh, Kingpin marks the Group’s latest move into the consumer-facing whisky category, adding another offering to India’s competitive Indian Made Foreign Liquor (IMFL) market.
Food brand Kkhavo, known for its heritage Kala Namak Rice, has entered the cookware segment with the launch of Kkhavo Kitchen, a premium range of Tri-Ply Mini Cookware designed for smaller portions, quick meals, reheating and serving.
The new range comprises four products—Mini Kadahi, Mini Fry Pan, Mini Sauce Pan and Mini Square Pan—with individual pieces priced between Rs 699 and Rs 799. The Mini Kadahi, Mini Fry Pan and Mini Sauce Pan are also available as a three-piece set priced at Rs 1,749. As part of the festive launch, the brand is offering introductory discounts of up to 40%.
With Kkhavo Kitchen, the brand is expanding its food-focused portfolio into cookware, bringing together its existing food proposition with the manufacturing experience of Co-founder Mudit Goel.
Before founding Kkhavo, Goel built a stainless-steel business with experience spanning manufacturing, operations, supply chains and exports to international markets. The new cookware business draws on this background, with the brand positioning the range around quality, functionality and contemporary design.
“Kkhavo Kitchen brings together two journeys that are deeply connected to my experience. Having built a stainless-steel exports business and worked across international markets, I have always understood the importance of quality, functionality and precision in manufacturing,” said Mudit Goel, Co-founder, Kkhavo.
The Mini Cookware range features a three-layer construction comprising 304 stainless steel, an aluminium core and 430 magnetic stainless steel. According to the brand, the construction is designed to support even heat distribution and reduce hot spots.
The cookware is available in 12 cm to 15 cm formats, with capacities ranging from 550 ml to 600 ml. The pieces feature a brushed stainless-steel finish, silicone-grip handles and a stainless-steel cooking surface without an applied non-stick coating.
The range is compatible with induction and gas cooktops and follows a “Cook • Reheat • Serve” proposition, allowing consumers to use the same vessel across different stages of food preparation and serving.
Kkhavo Kitchen is positioning the mini-sized formats for smaller portions, quick meals, reheating and direct serving. The brand said the compact format is intended to offer versatility while taking up less space in the kitchen.
The cookware comes with a five-year warranty and is ISI certified. Its design combines a brushed-steel finish with subtle branding and silicone-grip handles.
The range allows Kkhavo to extend its positioning around food quality from ingredients into the cooking and serving process, while also entering a broader kitchenware market. The cookware range is being introduced ahead of the festive season, with discounts of up to 40% intended to support initial consumer trials.
Ranbir Kapoor has entered India's fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) sector with the launch of Flux Theory, a new personal care brand focused on the body wash category. The venture was founded in partnership with Advay Jhunjhunwala and venture-building platform Think9. Launched in Mumbai, Flux Theory enters the shower and personal care market with a range of body wash products designed around different consumer preferences, combining skincare benefits, fragrance profiles, and personality-led positioning.
The brand's initial portfolio includes five body wash variants: Sage, Sport, Lover, Dreamer, and Rebel. Each product has been developed with a specific fragrance profile and targeted skin-care benefits, including hydration, deep cleansing, exfoliation, brightening, and moisturisation. The range features fragrances such as bergamot, mint, santal, leather, and oud. According to the company, the products are intended to offer consumers a wider set of choices within the body wash segment beyond traditional functional attributes.
Flux Theory enters a category that continues to see growth in India. According to Euromonitor International, India's bath and shower market grew 4 percent in value during 2025 to reach retail sales of Rs 35,370 crore. Research by Mintel found that 65 percent of Indians were not using body wash in 2024, highlighting opportunities for category expansion. The company said its strategy is focused on attracting first-time body wash users while also encouraging existing consumers to explore alternatives within the shower care segment. The brand plans to build an omnichannel presence across digital and physical retail channels as it expands its reach.
As Founder, Ranbir Kapoor has been involved in developing the brand's proposition, product experience, creative direction, and visual identity from the early stages.
Kapoor said, “I have always been drawn to the idea that there is more than one side to each of us. As an actor, I experience that through the characters I play; in everyday life, we all move between different moods, roles and versions of ourselves. That was the thought behind Flux Theory. The shower is an everyday moment, but it can mark a shift in how you feel and what you are ready for next. That became the space in which we wanted to build Flux Theory. We have built each product around a distinct personality, fragrance and skin benefit, so people can choose what feels right for them in that moment. I’m excited to see Flux Theory start a new conversation in an everyday category and become a brand people return to as part of their routine.”
Advay Jhunjhunwala, Co-Founder, Flux Theory said, “The shower category has traditionally been led by function, familiarity and scale. While those remain important, consumers are increasingly looking for products that address specific skin needs and offer a more distinctive experience. Flux Theory brings together function, fragrance and personality in a way that gives consumers a new reason to choose body wash. Our ambition is to grow the category, bring more first-time users into it and give existing consumers a reason to switch. Ultimately, a daily-use brand earns its place through the product and the repeat purchase and that is what we are building towards.”
The Flux Theory product range is currently available through the brand's website as well as major e-commerce, beauty, and quick commerce platforms including Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Tira, Zepto, and Instamart. With the launch of Flux Theory, Kapoor joins a growing list of celebrities entering India's FMCG and personal care sector, as brands increasingly target younger consumers through differentiated products and omnichannel distribution strategies.
Rapido has expanded its food delivery business with the launch of Ownly in Hyderabad, making the city the platform’s second market after Bengaluru. The move marks the next phase of Ownly’s growth as it seeks to strengthen its presence in India’s food delivery sector. The food delivery app is now operational across Hyderabad, a city known for its strong food culture and large consumer base.
Through Ownly, Rapido is introducing a zero-commission model under which restaurants do not pay platform fees, while customers are charged a delivery fee based on the cost of the service. As part of the launch, Ownly highlighted the role of Rapido Captains, who will support food deliveries across the city alongside their existing responsibilities within Rapido’s mobility network. The company said the expansion is expected to create additional earning opportunities for Captains by enabling them to participate in food delivery demand.
To mark the launch, Ownly organised a gathering for Rapido Captains in Hyderabad. The event brought together delivery partners from across the city and was attended by Telugu actor Nani, who interacted with members of the Captain community.
Aravind Sanka, Co-Founder of Rapido and Ownly said, “Hyderabad is one of the most passionate food cities in the country, especially when it comes to biryani; and that makes it a natural next home for Ownly. Our model is simple: restaurants keep what they earn, customers pay only for their food and delivery, and nobody pays for anything in between. Bengaluru showed us that people respond to honesty in pricing, and we expect Hyderabad to hold us to it just as closely. It felt right to begin here with our captains, because they are the ones who carry this promise to every doorstep in the city.”
The company said its Captain network will continue to play a key role as Ownly scales operations across Hyderabad and expands its customer reach. Ownly's entry adds another player to Hyderabad’s food delivery market and reflects Rapido’s efforts to diversify beyond mobility services.
The platform is positioned around transparent pricing, affordability, and direct engagement with restaurants. With Hyderabad becoming its second operating city, Ownly is looking to expand its food delivery network while offering restaurants an alternative operating model and increasing delivery opportunities for Rapido Captains.
Mount Everest Breweries Limited (MEBL), an Indore-based beer manufacturer, has filed its Draft Red Herring Prospectus (DRHP) with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) for an Initial Public Offering (IPO). The issue comprises a fresh issue of up to 11.5 million equity shares with a face value of Rs 10 each. According to the DRHP, the company may also undertake a pre-IPO placement before filing the Red Herring Prospectus with the Registrar of Companies (RoC). Any amount raised through the pre-IPO placement will be adjusted against the fresh issue size.
The company plans to utilise Rs 230 crore from the fresh issue proceeds towards capital expenditure for a proposed brewing facility with a capacity of 1 million hectolitres per annum (HLPA). Another Rs 70 crore will be used for repayment or pre-payment of certain borrowings, while the remaining funds will be allocated for general corporate purposes.
The IPO is being offered through the book-building process, with up to 50 percent of the net offer reserved for qualified institutional buyers, while non-institutional investors and retail individual investors will receive at least 15 percent and 35 percent of the allocation, respectively.
Founded in 1999, Mount Everest Breweries is a beer brewing company with operations spanning brewing, packaging, sales, and distribution across economy, core, and premium beer categories. The company held a market share of nearly 36.3 percent in Madhya Pradesh by production volume in FY 2026 and currently operates across 16 states and three union territories.
MEBL currently operates two brewing facilities. Its Simrol facility in Indore was established in 2008, while its Mysuru facility was acquired in 2025. The company is also involved in contract brewing and contract manufacturing for other beer brands and has a brewing arrangement in Assam to serve the North-East market. Its proprietary beer portfolio includes Mount’s 6000, Lemount, Mount’s Lager, Dabang, and Stok, catering to multiple consumer segments. As of August 31, 2026, the company's products were available through 22,229 retail outlets and touchpoints across India.
Mount Everest Breweries is part of the Associated Kedia Group, which also includes Associated Alcohols and Breweries Limited (AABL). While MEBL focuses on beer production and distribution, AABL operates in the Indian-Made Foreign Liquor (IMFL), Indian-Made Indian Liquor (IMIL), Extra Neutral Alcohol (ENA), and ethanol segments. Both companies function independently under a non-compete agreement signed in April 2026.
The company operates two key business verticals. The first is its proprietary beer brands business, which focuses on brewing, packaging, sales, and distribution of its owned brands. The second is its contract brewing business, where it manufactures and packages beer for third-party brand owners.
As of August 31, 2026, MEBL's distribution network covered 16 states and three union territories. The company has also exported its beer brands to markets including Mauritius, the UAE, and the United States. It serves 6,322 customers, including state excise departments, distributors, wholesalers, bars, restaurants, and hotels.
The company reported revenue from operations of Rs 1,017.8 crore in FY 2026, up from Rs 546.6 crore in FY 2024. Net profit rose to Rs 53.18 crore during FY 2026 compared to Rs 20.36 crore in FY 2024.
Beeline Capital Advisors Private Limited and Ashika Capital Limited are the book-running lead managers for the issue, while MUFG Intime India Private Limited has been appointed as the registrar. The equity shares are proposed to be listed on the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited.
V-Guard Industries has appointed Mithun K Chittilappilly as Chairperson of the Board, effective September 27, 2026, following the completion of the second and final term of Radha Unni as Chairperson and Independent Director. The appointment was approved by the company's Board of Directors as part of its leadership transition plan.
Chittilappilly, who has been serving as Managing Director since 2012, will now take on the additional responsibility of Chairperson while continuing to lead the consumer electronics and consumer durables company. He joined V-Guard in 2006 as Executive Director and has been associated with the company's growth and expansion over the past two decades. Under his leadership, V-Guard has expanded its presence across India, diversified its product portfolio, and strengthened its position in the electrical appliances, consumer electronics, and home solutions segments.
The leadership change follows the completion of Radha Unni's tenure on September 26, 2026. The board selected Chittilappilly to assume the role from September 27, ensuring continuity in the company's management and strategic direction.
V-Guard, which operates across multiple product categories in the consumer electricals and consumer durables market, has grown significantly during Chittilappilly's tenure. The company continues to focus on expanding its manufacturing footprint, product offerings, and nationwide distribution network.
The appointment marks a new phase in V-Guard's leadership structure as the company continues to strengthen its presence in India's consumer electronics and electrical appliances industry.
Consumer electronics brand Portronics has expanded its smart home product portfolio with the launch of the Mopcop Duo, a 3-in-1 cordless cleaning device that combines vacuuming, mopping and air blowing in a single unit.
Designed for everyday household cleaning, the device is powered by a brushless motor offering up to 17,000Pa of suction. It can be used to remove dust, crumbs, pet hair and other everyday debris across different surfaces.
The Mopcop Duo features two cleaning speed modes and runs on three 2,000mAh rechargeable batteries, offering up to 30 minutes of cordless runtime. The device also comes with a 90-degree flexible mop rod, allowing users to switch between vacuuming and mopping while accessing different floor areas.
The Portronics Mopcop Duo carries an MRP of Rs 6,999 and is currently listed at Rs 4,099 on the brand's website. It comes with a one-year warranty. The product is available through Portronics' online store, Amazon.in, Flipkart.com and other online and offline retail outlets across India.
The launch adds a multifunctional cleaning appliance to Portronics' broader portfolio of consumer electronics and smart gadgets, which spans audio, car accessories, computer accessories, mobile accessories and other technology products.
Beauty brand Swiss Beauty has expanded its eye makeup portfolio with the launch of AWAKEN, a four-product collection focused on long wear, precision and volume. The new range comprises the AWAKEN 3X Volume Mascara, AWAKEN 18-Hour Liquid Eyeliner, AWAKEN 24-Hour Kajal and AWAKEN Ultra-Precision Pen Eyeliner. The collection is now available across India through Swiss Beauty’s online and offline retail channels. The launch comes as eye makeup continues to occupy a key role in everyday beauty routines, with the brand focusing on performance-led product propositions across different formats.
Speaking about the launch, Mohit Goyal, Co-Founder & Director, Swiss Beauty, said, “At Swiss Beauty, innovation begins with understanding what consumers expect from their beauty products. AWAKEN has been developed with that thought at its core, bringing together four essential eye makeup formats with propositions that are clear, purposeful and rooted in performance. The way we have approached the launch is equally deliberate. We wanted to bring together personalities who could represent different expressions of beauty and help us take the collection into different consumer conversations. For us, AWAKEN is not just about launching four products; it is about creating a more contemporary and expansive conversation around eye makeup, with performance at its centre.”
The launch is supported by a multi-personality campaign featuring Sonakshi Sinha, Zaheer Iqbal, Sunanda Sharma, Kashish Kapoor and Sayani Gupta. Swiss Beauty said the selection was intended to represent different expressions of beauty and reach audiences across fashion, entertainment and digital culture.
The collection gives Swiss Beauty a broader eye makeup offering spanning volume, definition and precision. The company said the products are intended for both everyday routines and more expressive beauty looks. The AWAKEN launch adds four performance-focused products to its existing portfolio and is being distributed through the brand’s online and offline retail network across India.
Anera Silver by Kushals, founded by Kalpesh Gulechha, is set to open its first store in Bengaluru’s HSR Layout on September 26, marking the beginning of its retail expansion in India.
The brand plans to open six stores within the next eight weeks, with outlets averaging around 2,500 sq. ft. across key markets. Over the next five years, Anera Silver aims to build a network of 100–150 stores across India, with a first-year revenue target of ₹25 crore.
Located at Shop 822, Ground and Mezzanine, 27th Main Road, 1st Sector, HSR Layout, Bengaluru, the first store will offer jewellery across festive, gifting, bridal and everyday categories.
Positioned around design and self-expression, Anera Silver is looking to cater to diverse consumer needs and occasions. Its portfolio will span everyday jewellery alongside collections designed for festivals, celebrations, gifting and bridal wear.
Speaking about the launch, Kalpesh Gulechha, Founder, Anera Silver, said, “Jewellery becomes meaningful when it becomes part of people’s lives, their everyday moments, celebrations, milestones and personal stories. With Anera, our ambition is to create a brand where people come not simply to buy jewellery, but to discover design, experience craftsmanship and find pieces that feel personal to them.
“We believe there is a much larger opportunity to build aspiration around this category by bringing together strong design, a wide range of collections and an elevated retail experience. HSR is the beginning of that journey for us, and over the next few weeks consumers will see Anera Silver take shape across multiple cities.”
Gulechha brings more than two decades of experience in the jewellery industry, with expertise spanning retail strategy, merchandising, finance, expansion and consumer understanding through his association with Kushals.
Anera Silver is being developed as a separate brand proposition, with its own product portfolio, identity and retail format. The initial expansion will focus on establishing the brand across key markets through large-format stores.
With its five-year plan targeting 100–150 stores, Anera Silver is positioning its new retail network as the foundation for scaling its presence in India's silver jewellery market.
Blissclub has launched BareButter, its third menswear chapter, expanding its comfort-focused apparel portfolio for men. The new collection includes hoodies, quarter-zips and shorts, with a focus on softness, comfort and understated everyday styling.
The collection is positioned around the hours outside work, routines and other responsibilities. It is designed for occasions such as slower mornings, weekends, travel and everyday activities where comfort is a key consideration.
BareButter builds on Blissclub’s approach of using fabric innovation as a starting point for apparel. The collection focuses on creating garments that feel soft against the skin while maintaining a considered approach to everyday dressing.
Viswanathan V, CBO, Blissclub, said, “With BareButter, we are bringing our signature fabric and approach of comfort to menswear, creating a new expression of softness and ease for men.”
He added, “As we entered this space, we wanted to explore a part of menswear that felt less talked about. We wanted to ask a different question: who are you when nobody is asking anything of you?”
BareButter forms the third part of Blissclub’s menswear proposition. The brand’s Citywear collection focuses on everyday dressing, while its Activewear range is designed around movement and performance. BareButter adds a comfort-led offering aimed at personal, off-duty moments.
According to the company, the new chapter expands its understanding of everyday menswear by bringing softness and ease into a wider range of casual clothing.
Viswanathan said, “Comfort for us is not just about what you wear. It is about the parts of your life that are entirely your own.”
Blissclub has built its apparel proposition around proprietary fabrics designed for comfort and everyday performance. The company started with women’s apparel and expanded into menswear in February.
The menswear business extends the brand’s fabric-first approach into a broader category, with BareButter adding products designed for casual and relaxed use.
The latest collection includes three key product groups — hoodies, quarter-zips and shorts — reflecting the brand’s focus on versatile everyday clothing.
With BareButter, Blissclub is continuing its expansion in menswear while maintaining its broader focus on comfort-led apparel and fabric innovation.
Farmer-owned food company Two Brothers India Farms has launched a new range of fasting flours ahead of the Shardiya Navratri season, introducing Kuttu Atta, Singhara Atta and Unsprouted Rajgira Atta in 500 g packs.
The new range targets the seasonal demand for traditional fasting ingredients while bringing them into a packaged-food format. Each flour contains a single ingredient and is ground in small batches, with the brand focusing on minimal processing and ingredient traceability.
Kuttu, Singhara and Rajgira have traditionally been used in Indian households during fasting periods. With these ingredients increasingly available in packaged formats, the new range is positioned around ingredient transparency and maintaining the natural characteristics of the grains.
The Kuttu Atta is made from buckwheat and contains approximately 11.40 g of protein per 100 g. The flour can be used to prepare fasting dishes including Kuttu pakoras, puris and halwa. Singhara Atta, made from water chestnut, has a lighter texture and subtly sweet, earthy flavor. It can be used for preparations such as Singhara puris, parathas and halwa.
The third product, Unsprouted Rajgira Atta, is made from native-variety unsprouted amaranth. According to the company, the grain is kept whole before being ground in small batches. The flour contains approximately 14.53 g of protein per 100 g and can be used for dishes such as Rajgira laddoos, thalipeeth, porridge and kheer.
Commenting on the launch, Satyajit Hange, Co-founder & Farmer, Two Brothers India Farms, said, “Fasting has always been closely connected to the way our ancestors understood food, choosing simple, nourishing ingredients that were close to the source. Kuttu, Singhara and Rajgira are not new discoveries; they have been part of Indian food traditions for generations. With our fasting range, we wanted to stay true to that wisdom and bring these traditional flours to modern kitchens in their most authentic form.”
The launch expands Two Brothers India Farms’ portfolio of minimally processed pantry staples, which includes atta, ghee, cold-pressed oils, native grains, jaggery and other everyday food products. The company said the fasting range has been introduced specifically ahead of Shardiya Navratri, when Kuttu, Singhara and Rajgira see increased consumption across Indian households.
The products are available through the Two Brothers India Farms website in 500 g packs. Kuttu Atta is priced at an MRP of Rs 245, Singhara Atta at Rs 365 and Unsprouted Rajgira Atta at Rs 22.The fasting range adds a seasonal category to the company's existing pantry portfolio while bringing traditional vrat ingredients into a standardized, packaged format for modern consumers.
Radico Khaitan has refreshed the identity of its 1965 Spirit of Victory Lemon Dash Flavoured Rum as it looks to strengthen its presence in the premium flavoured rum segment. The new packaging has debuted in Assam, with a phased rollout planned across Odisha, Jharkhand, Tamil Nadu and West Bengal.
The Lemon Dash refresh builds on the 1965 Spirit of Victory franchise, which has crossed the million-case mark. The franchise was launched in 2017 as a tribute to the soldiers of the 1965 Indo-Pak war. It was initially introduced through the Canteen Stores Department (CSD) before being expanded into the domestic market following consumer response.
Lemon Dash was introduced in 2022 as the franchise’s entry into premium flavoured rum. The expression combines rum with Gandharaj lemon, targeting consumers exploring flavour-led drinks and different cocktail occasions.
Kunal Madan, Chief Marketing Officer, Radico Khaitan Limited, said, “1965 Spirit of Victory has always stood for a distinctive combination of heritage, pride and character. With Lemon Dash, we wanted to bring that heritage into a fresher, more expressive space.”
He added, “The new pack captures the contrast beautifully, the strength and character of the 1965 identity alongside the brightness of Gandharaj lemon.”
The refreshed identity uses a cream-and-gold colour palette with deep green accents, metallic detailing and illustrated Gandharaj lemons. The bottle features a tall, textured design with embossed details and the franchise’s roundel badge.
The four pillars associated with the franchise — Honour, Courage, Brotherhood and Glory — continue to form part of the packaging. The company said the new design is intended to connect the brand’s heritage with contemporary spirits consumption.
The rum has a citrus-led profile, combining the character of rum with the flavour of Gandharaj lemon. The expression has also received a Gold Quality Award from Monde Selection.
The refreshed Lemon Dash is currently available in Assam in three formats: a 750ml glass bottle with mono carton, a 375ml glass bottle and a 180ml glass bottle.
The new packaging will subsequently be introduced across other markets where Lemon Dash is present, including Odisha, Jharkhand, Tamil Nadu and West Bengal.
Radico Khaitan, which began operations in 1943 as Rampur Distillery Company, has developed a portfolio spanning whisky, rum, vodka, brandy, gin and Indian single malt. Its brands are available in more than 100 countries.
The company has owned distillery capacity of 323 million litres and operates 44 bottling units, including five owned and 39 contract and royalty bottling units. It also supplies branded Indian Made Foreign Liquor (IMFL) to the CSD and exports alcoholic beverages from India.
Contemporary fashion brand Awigna, founded by Varsha and Rittu Agarwal, has opened its new flagship store at The Corridors, Chhatarpur, Delhi, expanding its physical retail presence in the capital. The store provides Awigna with a dedicated retail space to showcase its collections and offer customers an in-person experience of the brand’s design language and craftsmanship.
The opening was marked by an event hosted by Co-Founders Varsha and Rittu, along with Liza, and attended by fashion influencers, industry members, friends, and family. The event also featured a fashion show showcasing Zevar, Awigna’s latest collection.
The new store has been designed around Awigna’s contemporary aesthetic, combining modern elements with an understated approach to elegance. The flagship is intended to give customers a closer experience of the brand’s collections and detailing in a physical retail environment.
Speaking about the store launch and the new collection, Varsha and Rittu Agarwal, Co-Founders of Awigna, said, “Opening our flagship store in Delhi is a very special moment for us. We wanted the space to reflect what Awigna stands for and give people the opportunity to experience our collections beyond the clothes themselves. With Zevar, we have explored the beauty of jewellery through embroidery, detailing and delicate embellishments. It has been wonderful to bring the collection to life and celebrate this new chapter with our friends, family and the fashion community.”
With the new store, Awigna is strengthening its presence in Delhi through an offline retail format while giving its growing fashion audience a dedicated space to explore its collections.
Gourmet QSR brand Tossin Pizza has expanded beyond its core pizza offering with the launch of its Classic Tiramisu, marking its entry into the dessert category. Inspired by the traditional tiramisu of Treviso in Italy’s Veneto region, the new offering has been developed over nearly six months of research and development.
Led by Founder & Chef Rohit Narang, the recipe focuses on traditional Italian ingredients and preparation while maintaining Tossin Pizza’s emphasis on ingredient quality and handcrafted food.
“Tiramisu has always been one of those desserts I personally keep going back to. Travelling through Italy gave me an even deeper appreciation for how much character there can be in something that looks deceptively simple,” said Rohit Narang, Founder & Chef, Tossin Pizza.
“For us, the challenge was not to reinvent tiramisu. It was to make one we genuinely wanted to eat ourselves. We spent six months refining everything, from the Italian Savoiardi and espresso to the mascarpone, cocoa layering and balance of rum. We wanted every ingredient to have a role without any one of them overpowering the dessert,” he added.
The 250 g Classic Tiramisu is made with Savoiardi biscuits imported from Italy, premium mascarpone, freshly brewed espresso, eggs, cocoa and rum. Tossin said approximately 2 ml of rum is used per portion, while the coffee profile has been designed to remain smooth rather than aggressively bitter.
The brand has also adopted a specific layering technique for the cocoa. Instead of using cocoa only as a finishing dusting, the kitchen adds it after each layer of cream, allowing its bittersweet notes to feature throughout the dessert.
The recipe has been designed with restrained sweetness, allowing the espresso, mascarpone and cocoa to remain the dominant flavors. Each portion is assembled by hand using a standardized recipe to maintain consistency across outlets.
The launch represents a broader menu expansion for Tossin Pizza, which has built its positioning around gourmet, ingredient-focused pizzas. With the tiramisu, the brand is extending this approach into desserts while keeping the product as a permanent menu offering.
Priced at Rs 399 plus taxes for 250 g, the Classic Tiramisu is currently available across Tossin Pizza outlets in Gurgaon. Since the dessert is prepared fresh, the brand recommends immediate consumption for the intended texture and flavor experience.
With the launch, Tossin Pizza is moving beyond its core pizza category and adding a traditional Italian dessert to its menu, giving consumers another occasion to engage with the brand beyond its primary offering.
Amazon has expanded its quick commerce service Amazon Now to Amritsar and Jaipur, strengthening its presence in India's fast-growing instant delivery market. The move is part of the company's broader strategy to scale ultra-fast deliveries across the country ahead of the festive season. With the launch, customers in both cities can order a range of products including groceries, fruits and vegetables, frozen foods, personal care products, beauty essentials, fashion items, home care products, and small appliances, with deliveries completed within minutes.
Amazon said consumer demand in Amritsar is showing strong interest in health and nutrition products, personal care items, and home care essentials, reflecting changing shopping preferences in Tier II markets.
Srikant Sree Ram, Director, Everyday Essentials, Amazon India said, "Amazon Now has crossed $1 billion in annualized gross sales in India, with orders doubling every quarter since launch, making it the fastest-growing e-commerce business unit in Amazon India's history. As we scale to 100 cities by Diwali, customers in Amritsar can look forward to the same promise we have built over the past decade ..."
According to the company, Amazon Now has expanded to more than 60 cities and towns across India in less than 10 weeks. The service is already available in several Tier II and Tier III locations, including Gurdaspur, Jalandhar, Tirupati, Guntur, Vellore, Dharwad, Warangal, and Berhampur.
Amazon has been rapidly increasing its quick commerce footprint as competition intensifies in the instant delivery segment. Earlier this year, the company announced plans to expand Amazon Now to 100 cities supported by a network of more than 1,000 micro-fulfilment centres. The latest rollout highlights Amazon's continued investment in quick commerce, online grocery delivery, and last-mile logistics as consumer demand for faster delivery services continues to grow across both metro and non-metro markets in India.
Nykaa and BOLD (Business Opportunities for L’Oréal Development), the corporate venture capital fund of L’Oréal, have announced a collaboration to invest in high-growth Indian beauty, wellness, and personal care brands. Under the partnership, the two companies will jointly take minority stakes in emerging Indian beauty and wellness businesses that have demonstrated strong consumer demand and differentiated product offerings.
The investments will remain financial and minority in nature, allowing founders to retain ownership control and continue operating their businesses independently. The initiative is aimed at supporting the next generation of Indian beauty entrepreneurs by combining access to capital with strategic guidance. In addition to funding, participating brands will have the opportunity to benefit from L’Oréal’s global beauty expertise and Nykaa’s omnichannel retail capabilities, consumer insights, and distribution network.
The collaboration comes at a time when India's beauty and personal care market continues to attract investor interest, driven by growing consumer spending, digital commerce adoption, and rising demand for homegrown beauty brands.
Jacques Lebel, Managing Director, L’Oréal India said, “India is one of the most exciting beauty markets in the world, and its energy comes both from an expanding base of demanding consumers with rapidly evolving needs and from its ecosystem of tremendous entrepreneurs. Through BOLD and this partnership with Nykaa, we want to stand behind that talent backing founders with capital, mentorship, and L’Oréal’s beauty expertise, while leaving them free to build their brands their way. Our commitment to India is stronger than ever, and this is the next major milestone in a journey of partnership and growth that we began over three decades ago.”
Anchit Nayar, Executive Director and CEO, Nykaa Beauty added, “Nykaa and L’Oréal have been partners in India for over a decade, working together on our shared vision of making India into one of the world's largest and fastest growing beauty markets. The experience and lessons we have learned along the way have allowed us to understand what it takes to build a promising brand into an enduring one. Combining our strong consumer ecosystem, deep retail network and wide distribution, along with L’Oréal’s global beauty expertise will be an incredibly valuable asset to the next generation of founders as they look to build consumer brands that India can be proud of.”
The move further strengthens the long-standing relationship between Nykaa and L’Oréal in India and reflects growing efforts to support innovation within the country's beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness, and personal care sectors.
German bathroom solutions brand Hansgrohe has strengthened its presence in Punjab and Haryana with the launch of Avalegra, as part of its expansion strategy in the Chandigarh-Mohali-Panchkula region. The move reflects the company’s focus on growing its footprint in North India’s premium home and luxury housing markets.
Avalegra combines a basin and mixer system designed to offer multiple water flow options while integrating design and functionality into a single bathroom solution. The product features a wide rain spray that flows from below in a parabolic curve and a LaminarSpray from a swivel spout. According to the company, the coordinated basin and mixer design helps reduce splashback, while an integrated thermostat and dual controls allow users to regulate water temperature, flow, and spray modes.
Avalegra is available with a plug-and-play installation system, two basin sizes, and five FinishPlus finishes.
Vishal Gupta, Commercial Director, Sales and Marketing, Hansgrohe India said, “The tricity is showing a major phenomenon the country is going through - that of the premium bathroom segment witnessing a shift towards experience. The demand for integrated, design-led solutions for unique water experiences that don’t compromise on performance and long-term value has been on a steady rise. Chandigarh-Mohali-Panchkula are a trendsetter trio for premium and luxury living across Punjab and Haryana, with consumers here demonstrating a strong appetite for high-end shopping, luxury dining, design and lifestyle experiences. Avalegra answers those aspirations, bringing together technology, contemporary design and a distinctive water experience. As we strengthen our presence in the region, we see the Tricity as an important hub for our plans for North Indian premium consumers.”
The launch forms part of Hansgrohe India’s broader strategy to strengthen its retail presence and expand experiential formats across North India. The company said it is exploring opportunities to deepen engagement with homeowners, architects, interior designers, and developers through its premium bathroom solutions portfolio.
The company highlighted the growth of the Tricity residential market as a key factor behind its expansion plans. Mohali has emerged as a significant premium housing market, supported by residential development, infrastructure growth, and improved connectivity.
According to industry data cited by the company, Mohali recorded a 34 percent increase in housing sales in 2025, while new housing launches grew by 108 percent. Across 15 Tier II cities tracked by PropEquity, homes priced above Rs 1 crore registered 9 percent growth in sales during 2025. Hansgrohe noted that rising demand for premium housing, luxury residences, and design-focused living spaces is contributing to increased interest in premium bathroom products and home improvement solutions across the region.
Naman Gupta, Gupta Bath Luxuria said, “The Tricity is seeing growing interest in premium, design-led bathroom solutions, and consumers are increasingly looking for products that combine aesthetics with technology and functionality. Our association with hansgrohe allows us to bring these global innovations closer to customers in the region, and Avalegra is a strong example of how the bathroom experience is evolving.”
Discussing the broader premiumization trend, Vishal Gupta added, “Premiumisation for us is about being more considered; it is about creating and experiencing better. Life is ‘Waterful’ when technology, design and responsible water use come together to make everyday experiences more meaningful. Our water-saving technologies demonstrate that it is possible to reduce water consumption by up to 60 percent while maintaining the quality and comfort of the experience. This is the direction in which we see the premium bathroom category evolving where design, technology, wellness and water conservation can go hand in hand.”
Hansgrohe continues to expand its retail network and bathroom solutions portfolio in India, focusing on premium housing markets where demand for smart bathroom technology, sustainable water solutions, and design-led home products is increasing.
Quick commerce platform bigbasket has partnered with The Coca-Cola India to roll out a delivery partner welfare initiative aimed at improving access to refreshments and drinking water at high-activity delivery locations across India. The program will begin in Bengaluru and expand to other cities in phases. As part of the initiative, delivery partners will be able to access beverages and packaged drinking water at key pickup hubs and quick commerce dark store locations.
The rollout is being executed through bb Instant, bigbasket’s automated smart vending network. Touchscreen vending machines are being installed at locations with high delivery rider traffic, including quick commerce dark stores and major delivery pickup points. The vending machines will offer beverages from The Coca-Cola India portfolio, including Coca-Cola, Thums Up, Sprite, Fanta, Limca, Maaza, Kinley packaged drinking water, and Kinley soda. Delivery partners can purchase and collect beverages directly from the machines during their working hours.
Parankush Pantu, National Business Head – bb Instant, bigbasket said, “Every order reaches a customer because a delivery partner makes that final mile possible. At bigBasket, supporting our delivery partners is an important part of building a strong and trusted business. This collaboration with Coca-Cola is a step towards making refreshments and drinking water more accessible during their workday and helping make long hours on the road a little more comfortable.”
The initiative is part of bigbasket’s broader efforts to support delivery partners working in the fast-growing quick commerce sector. The company noted that last-mile delivery personnel often spend extended hours on the road while managing deliveries across varying weather and traffic conditions.
Sujoy Jana, Chief Projects and Customer Experience Officer, bigbasket said, “This initiative is about making refreshment access simple and convenient for delivery partners during their workday. By using the bb Instant network, we can scale this support across high-activity delivery locations in multiple cities.”
The Coca-Cola Company is supporting the initiative through its beverage portfolio and vending machine infrastructure, helping establish a refreshment network across key delivery hubs.
Abhishek Gupta, Vice President, Customer Development, Coca-Cola India and Southwest Asia said, “Delivery partners are integral to India’s rapidly growing quick commerce landscape. We are pleased to collaborate with Big Basket for an initiative that brings accessibility, convenience, and refreshment to delivery partners throughout their working hours. With bigbasket’s on-ground network, Coca-Cola’s beverage and vending capabilities, we aim to offer a practical and scalable solution that meets the delivery partners everyday need across cities.”
The Bengaluru rollout is already underway, with additional cities expected to be added in the coming months. The partnership highlights the growing focus among quick commerce companies on delivery partner welfare, employee support programs, and last-mile logistics infrastructure as the sector continues to expand across India.
Parag Milk Foods Limited has announced plans to invest around Rs 100 crore to expand its paneer manufacturing capacity from 20 MT per day to 80 MT per day across its facilities in Manchar, Maharashtra, and Palamaner, Andhra Pradesh. The expanded units, which will manufacture both regular and high-protein paneer, are expected to be operational by June 2027. The move comes as demand for branded dairy products and protein-rich foods continues to rise across India. Paneer remains one of the company’s key value-added dairy categories, recording growth of 28 percent annually over the last two years.
Value-added products currently contribute more than 90 percent of Parag Milk Foods’ overall turnover. The company said the latest investment will support its efforts to strengthen its presence in the organised dairy segment while increasing production capacity for its paneer portfolio.
Paneer is among the largest categories in the Indian dairy market. Industry trends indicate a gradual shift from unorganised to organised players, which currently account for only about 5-6 percent of the category. Consumers are increasingly opting for branded and packaged dairy products that offer consistent quality and food safety standards.
Parag Milk Foods said the capacity expansion will help strengthen its distribution reach across India for both its regular and high-protein paneer offerings. The company’s branded paneer portfolio offers a shelf life of up to 75 days without preservatives through its manufacturing and packaging technology. The company plans to leverage its manufacturing infrastructure and nationwide distribution network to increase paneer availability across General Trade, Modern Trade, Quick Commerce, E-commerce, and HoReCa channels. The expansion is expected to support wider distribution while maintaining product quality and freshness.
The investment aligns with Parag Milk Foods’ strategy of scaling high-growth value-added dairy categories, strengthening its branded product portfolio, and responding to growing consumer demand for packaged dairy products.
Rahul Kumar Srivastava, COO, Parag Milk Foods Limited said, “Paneer is an important part of the Indian consumer’s diet. We have the manufacturing excellence to maintain the freshness and quality of paneer over an extended period. We are pleased to announce our plan to add 60 MT/day of capacity, taking our overall paneer capacity from 20 MT/day to 80 MT/day. This scale-up will allow us to expand our pan-India distribution and make our paneer available across distribution channels. We see a significant opportunity to strengthen our position in value-added dairy through innovation, scale and wider consumer access.”
The outlook for the category remains strong. According to an IMARC report, the Indian paneer market was valued at Rs 73,140 crore in 2025 and is projected to reach Rs 2.15 lakh crore by 2034, growing at a CAGR of 12.34 percent between 2026 and 2034. The growth is being driven by increasing demand for protein-rich foods, rising adoption of branded dairy products, expansion of organised retail, and the rapid growth of e-commerce and quick commerce platforms.
Campus Activewear has opened its first reimagined retail-format store in Roop Nagar, New Delhi, as the sports and athleisure brand looks to strengthen its physical retail presence and expand its proposition beyond footwear.
Spread across 1,640 sq. ft., the new store introduces Campus Activewear’s redesigned retail concept, with dedicated spaces for product discovery, styling and consumer interaction. The store was inaugurated by Gautam Gambhir, Head Coach of the Indian cricket team.
The new format is designed around a contemporary, minimalist retail environment, incorporating curated product displays, styling boards, lifestyle imagery and interactive elements such as lace customisation and a dedicated photo-op area.
The store houses a wider product portfolio spanning lifestyle and sneakers, running, walking, ELAN, women’s and kids’ footwear, along with apparel, accessories, bags, slippers and sandals.
According to Nikhil Aggarwal, CEO, Campus Activewear, the company sees the evolving sports and athleisure market as an opportunity to expand its consumer base and strengthen its retail presence.
“The Indian sports and athleisure market is at an exciting stage, with consumers increasingly seeking products and brands that fit seamlessly into their everyday lives. For Campus Activewear, this presents an opportunity to build on our scale and strengthen our relevance across a much broader consumer landscape,” Aggarwal said.
He added that the company’s focus is on long-term growth, market expansion and building capabilities to serve changing consumer demand.
Campus Activewear Expands Retail Network
Campus Activewear currently operates 311 exclusive stores across India, including 41 stores in Delhi NCR. The company identifies Delhi NCR as a key growth market and sees potential to expand its presence to more than 60 stores in the region in the coming years.
The Roop Nagar outlet forms part of the company’s broader retail expansion strategy as it seeks to take its growing product portfolio closer to consumers across Tier I and Tier II markets.
The new store format also reflects the brand’s attempt to integrate footwear, apparel and accessories within a single retail environment, supporting its transition towards a broader sports and lifestyle proposition.
Campus Takes ‘Move Your Way’ to Delhi’s Student Community
Alongside the store launch, Campus Activewear is running a two-week ‘Move Your Way’ shoe truck activation around Roop Nagar and North Campus. The initiative includes fitness challenges and open talent activities, with winners receiving coupons and merchandise.
The Roop Nagar store is now operational, offering Campus Activewear’s expanded range across footwear, apparel and accessories.
Instamart, India’s quick commerce platform, has announced plans to strengthen its battery-swapping infrastructure through partnerships with Yulu, an electric mobility-as-a-service (MaaS) provider, and Yuma Energy, a battery-swapping network operator. The initiative is aimed at making electric vehicle (EV) adoption more accessible and practical for last-mile delivery partners by addressing vehicle affordability and charging-related downtime.
As part of the initiative, Instamart will work with Yuma Energy to bring battery-swapping stations closer to delivery partners by providing space at its PODs, or dark stores, for the installation of swapping infrastructure. The first such battery-swapping station was inaugurated earlier this month at an Instamart POD in the presence of Anant Choudhary, VP - Driver & Delivery Org, Instamart, and Deepak Nanwani, Head of Revenue and Operations, Yuma Energy.
Yuma Energy currently operates more than 2,000 battery-swapping units across its network. According to the company, each battery swap takes less than two minutes. For delivery partners who typically travel over 90 km per day, easy access to swapping stations can significantly reduce downtime. Instamart estimates that locating these stations near operational hubs can help delivery partners save up to 60 minutes daily that would otherwise be spent travelling to and waiting at charging or swapping points.
Anant Choudhary, VP, Driver & Delivery Org - Instamart said, "The next phase of EV adoption is about making electric mobility work in the day-to-day reality of last-mile delivery. That means making vehicles more accessible, keeping operating costs low, and cutting down on charging downtime. Our partnerships with Yulu and Yuma Energy are focused on solving these practical challenges together. As Instamart continues to work towards electrification of the last mile, we are focused on building an ecosystem that makes this transition simpler and more viable in every way for our delivery partners."
Deepak Nanwani, Head of Revenue and Operations, Yuma Energy shared, "For a delivery rider, the EV transition comes down to one question: does this vehicle make me more money per shift than what I'm using today. Affordability gets someone into the vehicle and its uptime and energy access that decide the earning opportunity. Pairing EV access with a swapping network solves both sides of that equation at once, the rider isn't carrying downtime risk."
Alongside battery-swapping infrastructure, Instamart is also working with Yulu to improve EV affordability for delivery partners. Through the collaboration, delivery partners using Yulu electric two-wheelers on the Instamart platform can access rental cashback incentives, reducing the cost of adopting electric mobility.
Since the programme was introduced in May 2026, the company says thousands of delivery partners have benefited from the initiative. The scheme has helped participating riders lower their rental expenses by up to 30 percent, while also reducing their dependence on fluctuating fuel prices.
Blum, the Austrian manufacturer of premium furniture fittings and hardware solutions, has expanded its presence in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region with the inauguration of a new Experience Centre at Vision Enterprises in Sector 19C, APMC Market 1, Vashi, Navi Mumbai.
The new facility has been designed as an interactive destination where homeowners, architects, interior designers and furniture makers can explore Blum’s hardware solutions in a real-life residential setting. The launch aligns with the company’s strategy to strengthen its footprint in the region while bringing its furniture fitting innovations closer to consumers and trade professionals.
The experience centre was jointly inaugurated by Maarten de Vries, Managing Director, Blum India, and Vijay Singh Chandaliya, Owner of Vision Enterprises. Located within Navi Mumbai’s key hardware and building materials hub, the facility enables visitors to interact with Blum’s product range and experience its functionality firsthand.
Maarten de Vries, Managing Director, Blum India said, "The booming residential ecosystem of Navi Mumbai demands a premier living experience. We opened Blum's experience centre in Vashi to make world-class Austrian engineering easily accessible to the city. The centre not only brings our furniture hardware here but also allows visitors to get hands-on with the motion, ergonomics, and quality that our solutions are loved for all over the globe. I want to thank our local partners at Vision Enterprises for bringing us closer to the people of Vashi and helping us set up this experience centre for the furniture makers and homeowners here."
Vijay Singh Chandaliya, Owner of Vision Enterprises shared, "I have been in the Navi Mumbai hardware market for years, so I know what clients around Vashi expect when they build a home. Partnering with Blum to open this space right here is fantastic because it means local designers and architects don't have to drive into Mumbai anymore just to see top-tier fittings. Everything they need is on display right here in Vashi. We want people to come in, use the setups, and see how much of a difference the right hardware makes."
The newly opened experience centre is now operational and welcomes walk-in visitors. In addition to product demonstrations, the facility offers opportunities for homeowners and builders to consult with modular kitchen designers and explore furniture layouts using Blum’s hardware solutions.
Real estate developer Trehan IRIS has announced the appointment of Prasad Rane as its Chief Business & Marketing Officer (CBMO) as the company looks to strengthen its growth strategy across residential, commercial, and retail real estate segments.
In his new role, Rane will oversee business growth, sales and marketing functions, bringing together commercial strategy, brand development, customer experience and go-to-market initiatives across the organization. The company said his mandate will focus on aligning business performance with brand strategy while creating differentiated value propositions across the Trehan IRIS portfolio.
Abhishek Trehan and Aman Trehan, Executive Directors, Trehan IRIS shared, “Prasad brings a strong combination of business, brand and consumer understanding, with experience across real estate, retail and consumer businesses. His mandate will be to bring business growth, sales and marketing closer together as we enter our next phase of growth. We are pleased to welcome him to the leadership team.”
Prasad Rane, Chief Business & Marketing Officer, Trehan IRIS said, “Real estate today is no longer only about what we build; it is increasingly about the experience, proposition and value we create around it. Trehan IRIS has a strong legacy and an exciting opportunity to build the next phase of the organisation around that foundation. My focus will be to bring business, sales, brand and customer experience closer together — creating propositions that are distinctive for the consumer and meaningful for the business.”
The appointment comes at a time when Trehan IRIS is expanding its presence across multiple real estate categories. With more than seven decades of industry experience, the company’s portfolio spans residential, commercial, retail and hospitality developments, with a focus on creating community-driven and customer-centric spaces.
Rane brings extensive cross-industry experience across real estate, retail, consumer brands, asset management, marketing and business development. Over the course of his career, he has worked on initiatives related to real estate asset management, retail destination development, and business growth strategies.
Before joining Trehan IRIS, Rane served as Chief Growth Officer at DailyObjects, where he led offline business expansion, physical retail growth and the development of new business channels.
Prior to that, he was associated with ICS Group, serving as Chief Marketing Officer at PPZ and CEO of SPACES. During his tenure, he worked across asset management, retail and mixed-use developments, technology parks and public spaces. His earlier experience in advertising and retail also contributed to his expertise in consumer behavior, brand building and business development.
Beauty and lifestyle retailer Nykaa has launched its K-Beauty Festival in Bengaluru, transforming Forum Mall into a dedicated Korean Beauty Village that will remain open until September 27.
The experiential beauty event brings together a wide range of Korean skincare, makeup and haircare brands, offering consumers an opportunity to explore some of the most popular names in the global K-beauty industry under one roof.
The skincare portfolio at the festival includes brands such as Dr. Althea, Beauty of Joseon, COSRX, Anua, Biodance, SKIN1004, Round Lab, Arencia, Aestura, Illiyoon, Medicube, The Face Shop, Mirabelle Korea and Laneige. In the makeup segment, shoppers can discover products from D’alba Piedmont, TIRTIR, Tonymoly and Mamonde, while Korean haircare brands including La’dor, Mise En Scene and Ryo are also featured at the event.
Beyond product displays, the K-Beauty Village has been designed as an interactive experience. Visitors can test products, participate in games and activities, and receive samples and prizes. The event also includes promotional offers, with discounts of up to 20 percent available across selected K-beauty brands.
The initiative reflects growing consumer interest in Korean beauty products in India, particularly in categories such as skincare, sun care, sheet masks and advanced beauty formulations. By creating a dedicated experiential format, Nykaa aims to provide consumers with greater access to international beauty brands while allowing them to engage with products before making a purchase.
The festival caters to both long-time K-beauty enthusiasts and first-time shoppers interested in exploring Korean skincare and beauty trends. Consumers can browse a variety of products across categories, ranging from cleansers and moisturizers to makeup essentials and haircare solutions.
The event is part of Nykaa’s broader strategy to strengthen its beauty retail presence through curated brand experiences and global beauty offerings. Over the years, the retailer has expanded its portfolio of international beauty brands and introduced experiential formats aimed at increasing consumer engagement.
With the launch of the K-Beauty Festival in Bengaluru, Nykaa is further capitalizing on the rising popularity of Korean beauty products in India while creating an immersive retail experience that combines shopping, product discovery and interactive engagement.
The Korean Beauty Village at Forum Mall, Bengaluru, will continue to welcome shoppers until September 27, offering access to a wide selection of K-beauty brands, product trials and exclusive festival offers.
AceVector Ltd, the parent company of Snapdeal, has announced the launch of its initial public offering (IPO) on September 25, seeking a post-issue valuation of approximately Rs 1,741 crore. The company has fixed a price band of Rs 30-32 per equity share, with the public issue set to close on September 29.
At the upper end of the price band, the IPO is expected to raise around Rs 420 crore and value the e-commerce company at approximately Rs 1,741.4 crore. The anchor investor portion will open on September 24, ahead of the public subscription. The IPO comprises a fresh issue of shares worth up to Rs 287 crore and an offer for sale (OFS) by existing shareholders. Investors including SoftBank-backed Starfish and Nexus Venture Partners are among those participating in the OFS.
AceVector had earlier proposed a larger public issue but has revised the size of both the fresh issue and the OFS. The company plans to deploy the fresh capital towards marketing and business promotion, technology infrastructure investments, acquisitions, and general corporate purposes.
Founded by Kunal Bahl and Rohit Bansal, AceVector operates a digital commerce ecosystem spanning multiple businesses, including value-focused e-commerce marketplace Snapdeal, e-commerce enablement platform Unicommerce, and consumer brand business Stellaro Brands.
According to its latest filings, the company reported revenue of Rs 510.4 crore in FY26, up 29.2 percent from the previous fiscal year, while its net loss narrowed significantly during the period. The IPO comes amid renewed activity in India’s primary market, with several technology, e-commerce and digital-first companies tapping public markets to fund growth and strengthen their balance sheets.
Menswear brand Wrogn, backed by cricketer Virat Kohli, reported a recovery in revenue during FY26, although the company continued to face profitability pressures as losses increased during the year.
Wrogn’s operating revenue rose 9 percent to Rs 244 crore in FY26, compared to Rs 223 crore in FY25, when the company had recorded a decline in sales. Despite the growth, the brand remained significantly smaller than fast-growing competitors such as Snitch and Rare Rabbit, which reported revenues of approximately Rs 900 crore and Rs 1,100 crore, respectively.
Founded in 2014 and operated by Universal Sportsbiz Private Limited (USPL), Wrogn offers a range of casual menswear products, including T-shirts, shirts, denim, and accessories. The Bengaluru-based company is backed by investors including Virat Kohli, Accel, and Aditya Birla Group, and distributes its products through both online and offline retail channels.
Product sales continued to account for the majority of the company's income.
