a.content:
Nykaa Acquires 51 Percent Stake in Skincare Brand Aminu for Rs 32 Crore
    
          
            By
              siliconindia  |  Wednesday, 05 August 2026, 10:55 IST 
                                                                                         
        
                
      
	Nykaa has approved the acquisition of a 51% stake in premium D2C skincare brand Aminu for up to Rs 32 crore. The deal will strengthen Nykaa’s owned beauty portfolio and expand its presence in the premium skincare segment.
	Beauty and personal care platform Nykaa is expanding its premium skincare portfolio by acquiring a majority stake in direct-to-consumer (D2C) skincare brand Aminu. Nykaa’s board has approved the acquisition of a 51% stake in Aminu for a cash consideration of up to Rs 32 crore.
	According to exchange filings, the transaction is expected to be completed by September 15. Nykaa also plans to acquire the remaining 49% stake in Aminu over the next few years.
	The founders of Aminu will continue to manage the company’s operations, while Nykaa will support the brand’s growth by leveraging its platform, distribution network, and market reach.
	Founded in 2019 by Prachi Bhandari and Aman Mohunta, Aminu offers premium skincare products, including serums, cleansers, sunscreens, masks, moisturizers, and body care products. The brand currently has over 60 stock-keeping units (SKUs) and also provides personalized skin consultation services.
	Aminu operates in the premium skincare category, a segment where Nykaa is looking to expand its presence. The company said Aminu’s products have a higher price point compared with several existing brands under the Nykaa portfolio, helping it fill a gap in the premium skincare market.
	The acquisition will also help Nykaa strengthen its in-house skincare capabilities. Aminu has more than 30 proprietary formulations and focuses on research and development-driven products.
	The brand’s omnichannel presence was another factor behind Nykaa’s investment decision. Aminu sells products through its own website, beauty platforms such as Nykaa and Clinikally, e-commerce marketplaces including Amazon and Zepto, and is also available across 180 salons in India.
	The D2C brand has recorded strong growth in recent years. Aminu reported revenue of Rs 19.4 crore in FY26, registering a nearly 50% increase from around Rs 13 crore in FY25.
	According to Aminu, the brand sources ingredients from more than 40 countries and uses over 250 ingredients across its product range. It focuses on clean skincare formulations and claims to have removed nearly 3,000 commonly used ingredients from its products.
	The acquisition aligns with Nykaa’s broader strategy of building its 'House of Brands' portfolio across different beauty categories and price segments. In the past, Nykaa has acquired or invested in beauty brands such as Dot & Key and Earth Rhythm as part of this strategy.
	Currently, Nykaa’s portfolio includes seven beauty and personal care brands and five fashion brands, including its own Nykaa Cosmetics line. The company plans to continue expanding into categories such as premium fragrances, mid-premium nutraceuticals, derma skincare, and professional makeup products.
	The deal comes alongside Nykaa reporting strong financial performance for the first quarter of FY27. The company posted a more than threefold increase in consolidated net profit to Rs 79.8 crore, compared with Rs 24.8 crore in the same quarter last year. Its operating revenue rose 29% year-on-year to Rs 2,782 crore.
	Following the announcement, Nykaa shares closed 0.85% higher at Rs 344.80.
	With this acquisition, Nykaa is strengthening its position in India’s growing premium beauty market while supporting the expansion of homegrown skincare brands.

a.title: Nykaa shares pare gains after hitting 52-week high; here’s what Jefferies, Nomura, other analysts said on Q1 FY27 earnings
a.content:
Market News
4 min read | Updated on August 05, 2026, 12:29 IST
SUMMARY
Nykaa reported a 247% year-on-year surge in consolidated net profit to ₹80 crore for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 (Q1 FY27).
Stock list
FSN E-Commerce Ventures shares tumbled 6% from their 52-week high level to an intraday low of ₹327.7 apiece. Image: Shutterstock.
FSN E-Commerce Ventures shares tumbled 6% from their 52-week high level to an intraday low of ₹327.7 apiece. At the time of writing the piece, the stock was trading at ₹336.3 apiece on the National Stock Exchange, declining 1.81%.
Nykaa reported a 247% year-on-year surge in consolidated net profit to ₹80 crore for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 (Q1 FY27). In the corresponding quarter last year, the beauty and personal care retailer had posted a net profit of ₹23 crore.
The company’s revenue from operations increased 29% year-on-year (YoY) to ₹2,782 crore as compared to ₹2,155 crore in Q1 FY26.
On the operational level, Nykaa’s earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation (EBITDA) stood at ₹236 crore, marking a jump of 69% from ₹140 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous fiscal year. The company’s EBITDA margin also expanded to 8.4% in contrast to 6.5% YoY.
Nykaa’s beauty vertical GMV for Q1 FY27 stood at ₹4,105 crore. This includes performance across businesses of e-commerce, retail stores, eB2B distribution and the House of Nykaa Beauty portfolio. NSV growth came in at 29% YoY this quarter, accelerating from the mid-20s growth recorded over the past few quarters.
As India's largest beauty specialty retail network, the company expanded its beauty retail footprint to 324 stores across 105 cities, with total retail space increasing 29% YoY to ~3.3 lakh sq. ft.
Along with the earnings, Nykaa also said it acquired 51% stake in Aminu Wellness Private Limited, a premium dermocosmetic skincare brand, for a total consideration of ₹32 crore.
“This quarter marked continued acceleration in our growth momentum and EBITDA margins, both reaching their highest levels in the last 12 quarters. Our AI-led initiatives are beginning to create meaningful consumer experiences, with Virtual Closet already driving 2x higher conversion and AskNykaa, our conversational search engine, emerging as a trusted beauty advisor on the platform,” said Falguni Nayar, Executive Chairperson, Founder and CEO of Nykaa.
Analysts from HSBC said FSN E-Commerce’s GMV performance remained robust, with the beauty and personal care (BPC) segment growing 28% and the fashion segment rising 53%. The analysts also noted that the company’s House of Brands continues to scale up.
They further highlighted that the EBITDA margin expanded by around 195 basis points year-on-year, marking the third consecutive quarter of over 150 basis points expansion, indicating that operating leverage is beginning to reflect.
Nomura analysts said growth is accelerating at FSN E-Commerce, with margin levers starting to play out. The analysts noted that EBITDA for Q1 FY27 came in ahead of consensus estimates, supported by premiumisation trends and AI-driven efficiencies.
The analysts expect Nykaa to sustain its strong growth momentum, with further margin expansion likely to be driven by premiumisation, an increase in brand partnerships, and the scaling up of its own brands.
Jefferies analysts in a note on Wednesday said Nykaa reported a strong beat across key metrics, with robust revenue growth, margins rising to a multi-quarter high, and a sharp increase in profits. The analysts also added that valuations remain elevated but are supported by the firm’s strong growth and margin expansion.
According to NSE data, as of August 5, 2026, Nykaa has a total market capitalisation of ₹96,470.06 crore.

Investors looking at India's consumer sector may find better opportunities in liquor companies than cigarette makers, according to Abneesh Roy, Executive Director at Nuvama Institutional Equities. Roy said his highest-conviction idea is the alcoholic beverages space, driven by the possibility of major reforms in Tamil Nadu, where state-run liquor retailer Tamil Nadu State Marketing Corporation Limited (TASMAC) could be privatised.
"We like the alcobev space because Tamil Nadu clearly big reforms are likely. TASMAC is likely to get privatised, and it's a very big market," Roy said.
Among listed companies, he prefers United Spirits, Radico Khaitan and Allied Blenders and Distillers. He added that United Spirits offers additional valuation comfort because investors could benefit from a potential 10% dividend yield linked to the Indian Premier League (IPL) team sale.
On the other hand, while he believes the worst is over for cigarette companies, he expects another weak quarter. "Even in Q2, there will be a decline in terms of volumes and profit," he said, adding that he would prefer alcohol stocks over cigarette makers in the near term.

a.title: Nykaa turns creator culture into a content-to-commerce engine
a.content:
New Delhi: Nykaa placed creators and social content at the centre of its demand engine, with its network of more than 170,000 creators generating over 2.3 million content pieces annually.
FSN E-Commerce Ventures disclosed the numbers in its Q1 FY27 investor presentation filed with the BSE on August 4, 2026.
The scale pointed to a strategy that went beyond hiring influencers for isolated campaigns. Nykaa linked affiliate creators, social media content, product education, and shopping within a connected content-to-commerce ecosystem.
From influencer posts to in-app shopping
Nykaa brought creator content closer to transactions by embedding tutorials and influencer-recommended stores inside its shopping app.
Its content platform, Nykaa Play, surpassed 300,000 subscribers, combining beauty education, live content, and product discovery with shopping.
The model gave creators a role across the consumer journey, from introducing a product and explaining its use to directing consumers towards a purchase.
Nykaa also operated an affiliate programme through which creators could produce and distribute product-linked content.
A 19-million-strong social community
The company reported a social media community of more than 19 million followers across platforms.
Nykaa said it used differentiated content formats and collaborations to drive engagement, placing its social community alongside its customer base, brand assortment and physical distribution network.
The company’s presentation treated this ecosystem as a “social engine” within its wider demand, assortment and distribution flywheel.
This suggested that Nykaa viewed creator content as an always-on distribution channel, rather than only as campaign inventory.
Nykaa’s marketing and sales distribution expenditure stood at Rs 412 crore in Q1 FY27, up 26% year-on-year. However, the filing did not separately disclose the amount spent on creators or influencer marketing.
Creator culture moves beyond feeds
Nykaa extended creator and community engagement beyond social platforms through more than 20 immersive consumer events during the quarter.
The events included the Nykaa and L’Oréal Paris Cannes takeover, Beauty Bars, makeup masterclasses, experiential pop-ups, the Rare Beauty launch and new House of Nykaa brand events.
This gave the platform a mix of digital reach, creator-led recommendations and physical experiences around beauty culture.
The presentation cited that three in four Indian consumers relied on influencer recommendations for discovery and decisions. It also stated that creator content accounted for 76% of content consumption.
Content sits on top of a growing audience
Nykaa’s creator ecosystem operated alongside a consumer base of 60 million, which grew 33% year-on-year.
Its Pink Summer Sale attracted more than 35 million unique visitors and recorded over 100 million visits. The Nykaa Birthday Sale drew more than 20 million unique visitors and reported around 40% year-on-year GMV growth.
While Nykaa did not directly attribute these numbers to creator activity, they showed the size of the audience available to its content, social, and commerce ecosystem.

- Nykaa expanded margins as owned brands and operating leverage boosted profitability.
- Brokerages retained bullish ratings, seeing up to 40% upside in Nykaa shares.
Shares of FSN E-Commerce Ventures, the parent of Nykaa, fell nearly 3% on Wednesday despite the beauty and fashion retailer reporting a strong June-quarter performance, with higher revenue, expanding margins and a more than three-fold jump in net profit.
The stock declined as much as 3% even after the company posted revenue growth of 29.1% year-on-year to ₹2,782 crore. EBITDA rose 67.8% to ₹236 crore, while EBITDA margin expanded to 8.5% from 6.5% a year ago.
Net profit more than tripled to ₹80 crore from ₹24.5 crore in the corresponding quarter last year.
Nykaa's portfolio of 13 owned consumer brands continued to outperform, delivering 43% year-on-year growth. Beauty GMV increased 28% to ₹4,105 crore, while the fashion business maintained healthy momentum. During the quarter, the company added 11 stores, taking its offline network to 324 stores across more than 100 cities.
Nykaa also acquired a 51% stake in premium beauty and skincare brand Aminu Wellness for ₹32 crore. The brand reported FY26 revenue of ₹19.4 crore.

Growth Across Beauty And Fashion Impresses Brokerages
Brokerages remained positive on Nykaa's outlook, citing broad-based growth across beauty and fashion, improving profitability and continued operating leverage.
HSBC maintained its Buy rating with a target price of ₹380, while raising its FY27 EBITDA estimates by 3% after the earnings beat. The brokerage highlighted robust GMV growth, strong execution in the beauty business, scaling of the owned brands portfolio and sustained operating leverage.
CLSA reiterated its Outperform rating with a target price of ₹376, saying both revenue and EBITDA exceeded expectations. It noted that stronger brand partnerships accelerated fashion growth, while higher-margin owned brands continued to support profitability in the beauty segment.
Advertisement
Brokerages See Up To 40% Upside
Nomura retained its Buy rating and assigned the Street-high target price of ₹411, expressing confidence in Nykaa's long-term growth prospects. The brokerage expects premiumisation, expanding brand partnerships, continued growth in owned brands and deeper expansion into Tier-II and Tier-III cities to drive both revenue growth and margin expansion.
Jefferies also reiterated its Buy rating with a target price of ₹400, describing the June quarter as a strong beat across key operating metrics. It said healthy beauty user growth, premiumisation, more than 50% growth in the fashion business, the scaling up of Nykaa's house of brands and the increasing reach of its quick-commerce offering continue to strengthen the company's long-term growth outlook.

a.title: Nykaa steps up adex by 26% amid creator-led marketing push
a.content:
New Delhi: FSN E-Commerce Ventures, which operates beauty and fashion retailer Nykaa, increased its advertising and marketing outlay by 26% year-on-year to Rs 412 crore in the first quarter of FY27.
The expenditure stood at Rs 328 crore in the corresponding quarter of FY26 and Rs 380 crore in the March quarter of FY26, marking an 8% sequential rise, according to the company’s investor presentation filed with the BSE on August 4, 2026.
Despite the increase in absolute expenditure, marketing and S&D costs declined to 14.8% of revenue from operations, compared with 15.2% in Q1 FY26. The ratio, however, increased from 14.4% in Q4 FY26.
The company attributed the improvement in year-on-year cost efficiency to performance marketing efficiencies across its Beauty and Fashion platforms and improved business development executive productivity.
Nykaa’s contribution profit increased 37% to Rs 589 crore from Rs 430 crore in the year-ago quarter. Its contribution margin expanded to 21.3% from 19.9%.
Creator network and events support marketing push
Nykaa’s marketing ecosystem included more than 170,000 creators, 2.3 million content pieces generated annually and a social media community of over 19 million followers.
The company conducted more than 20 consumer events during the quarter, including the Nykaa and L’Oréal Paris Cannes takeover, Beauty Bars, makeup masterclasses, experiential pop-ups and the Rare Beauty launch event.
The Pink Summer Sale attracted more than 35 million unique visitors and recorded over 100 million visits. The Nykaa Birthday Sale registered around 40% year-on-year GMV growth and attracted more than 20 million unique visitors.
Consolidated EBITDA rises 68%
On a consolidated basis, Nykaa’s revenue from operations rose 29% year-on-year to Rs 2,782 crore from s 2,155 crore. Revenue increased 5% sequentially from Rs 2,648 crore in Q4 FY26.
Consolidated EBITDA increased 68% to Rs 236 crore from Rs 141 crore in Q1 FY26. It rose 3% from Rs 223 crore in the preceding quarter.
The EBITDA margin expanded to 8.5% from 6.5% in the year-ago period and 8.4% in Q4 FY26.
Consolidated profit after tax increased 226% year-on-year to Rs 80 crore from Rs 24 crore. PAT stood at Rs 79 crore in the preceding quarter. The PAT margin increased to 2.9% from 1.1% in Q1 FY26, but remained below the 3% reported in Q4 FY26.
Standalone revenue and profit decline
On a standalone basis, FSN E-Commerce Ventures reported revenue from operations of Rs 75.42 crore in Q1 FY27, compared with Rs 81.83 crore in Q1 FY26 and Rs 102.03 crore in Q4 FY26.
Standalone total income stood at Rs 127.69 crore, against Rs 121.93 crore in the corresponding quarter and Rs 163.16 crore in the preceding quarter.
Profit before tax declined to Rs 12.78 crore from Rs 17.44 crore in Q1 FY26 and Rs 49.74 crore in Q4 FY26.
Standalone profit after tax stood at Rs 9.57 crore, compared with Rs 12.92 crore in the year-ago quarter and Rs 41.04 crore in the March quarter.

a.title: Nykaa acquires majority stake in Aminu to strengthen premium skincare play
a.content:
Nykaa has announced the acquisition of a 51% stake in direct-to-consumer skincare brand Aminu for a cash consideration of up to ₹32 crore, as it strengthens its presence in the premium skincare segment. The transaction is expected to be completed by September 15, with the company planning to acquire the remaining 49% stake over the next few years.
Founded in 2019 by Prachi Bhandari and Aman Mohunta, Aminu offers a range of skincare and body care products including serums, cleansers, sunscreens, moisturisers and masks. The founders will continue to lead the business, while Nykaa will support its next phase of growth.
The acquisition adds a premium skincare brand to Nykaa's House of Brands portfolio. According to the company, Aminu's products are positioned at a higher price point than its existing skincare offerings, helping address a gap in its premium beauty portfolio. Nykaa also highlighted Aminu's research and development capabilities, with more than 30 proprietary formulations, as an important strategic advantage.
Aminu follows an omnichannel distribution model, selling through its own website, marketplaces including Nykaa, Amazon, Clinikally and Zepto, while also being available at over 180 salons across India.
The bootstrapped brand reported revenue of ₹19.4 crore in FY26, registering around 50% year-on-year growth from approximately ₹13 crore in FY25.
The acquisition is part of Nykaa's broader strategy to expand its portfolio of owned beauty brands across different categories and price segments. The company currently has seven beauty and personal care brands and five fashion brands under its House of Brands portfolio, and has previously acquired stakes in brands such as Dot & Key and Earth Rhythm. Nykaa has also identified premium fragrances, derma-led skincare, mid-premium nutraceuticals and professional makeup products as key growth areas for future expansion.

Mumbai, Aug 5: Five stocks are in focus on Wednesday, from Bharti Airtel’s strong subscriber-led earnings and ONGC’s blockbuster profit jump to BSE’s record quarter, Marico’s volume-led growth and Nykaa’s acquisition-backed beat. Here’s what’s driving each stock and what to track through the day.
Bharti Airtel (BHARTIARTL): Net profit rises 37.3% on record ARPU and subscriber additions
Bharti Airtel reported a consolidated net profit of Rs 8,167 crore for the April-June quarter of FY27, registering a 37.3 per cent year-on-year growth from Rs 5,948 crore in the same period last year. Consolidated revenue climbed 18.4 per cent to Rs 58,539 crore, aided by strong momentum across India and Africa operations, while India revenue rose 9.7 per cent to Rs 41,214 crore. The telecom operator’s India mobile ARPU rose to an industry-leading Rs 264 from Rs 250 a year earlier, helped by continued 2G-to-4G migration and premiumisation, while the company added 14.9 million customers globally to reach a base of 681 million across 15 countries. Investors will track commentary on tariff trends, capital expenditure and the ongoing scrutiny of the company’s Postpaid Fast Lane offering amid a regulatory review of net neutrality norms.
ONGC (ONGC): Net profit jumps 112% to Rs 17,034 crore, revenue up 45.2%
State-run Oil and Natural Gas Corporation reported a 112 per cent year-on-year increase in standalone net profit to Rs 17,034 crore in the first quarter of FY27. The upstream company’s revenue from operations rose 45.2 per cent year-on-year to Rs 46,460 crore in the quarter. Revenue from new well gas stood at Rs 3,998 crore, delivering an additional Rs 1,897 crore compared with the administered price mechanism gas price, with new well gas now contributing around 38 per cent of total revenue from ONGC’s nomination gas portfolio. However, ONGC’s consolidated net profit fell 43.3 per cent in the quarter on account of Hindustan Petroleum Corporation’s consolidated net loss of Rs 12,265 crore, driven by under-recoveries on petroleum products following the sharp rise in crude oil prices amid the West Asia crisis.
BSE (BSE): Net profit climbs 62% to Rs 874 crore on record quarterly performance
India’s oldest stock exchange reported a 62 per cent year-on-year increase in consolidated net profit attributable to shareholders for the June quarter, driven by higher operational revenue and stronger investment income. Profit attributable to shareholders rose to Rs 874 crore, compared with Rs 539 crore in the year-ago period, while total income surged 63 per cent to over Rs 1,700 crore. The exchange, which marked its 150th year of operations during the quarter, extended its streak to 14 consecutive quarters of record revenue, powered by a surge in its equity derivatives segment. Investors will watch trends in derivatives trading volumes and market share amid rising competition in the segment.
Marico (MARICO): Net profit rises 27% to Rs 652 crore on strong volume growth
The FMCG company reported a 27 per cent year-on-year rise in consolidated net profit to Rs 652 crore for the June quarter, compared with Rs 513 crore in the corresponding period last year, marking its strongest profit growth in 28 quarters. Revenue from operations increased 22.9 per cent to Rs 3,957 crore, driven by 11 per cent underlying volume growth in the India business and mid-teens constant-currency growth internationally. The maker of Parachute and Saffola raised its advertising spends 25 per cent year-on-year even as margins expanded, and reiterated its FY27 guidance of crossing Rs 15,000 crore in revenue alongside high-teen Ebitda growth.
Nykaa (NYKAA): Profit grows over 3-fold to Rs 79.8 crore on beauty and fashion strength
FSN E-Commerce Ventures, the parent of Nykaa, reported net profit rising more than three-fold to Rs 79.8 crore for the June quarter, from Rs 24.5 crore a year earlier. Revenue from operations jumped 29.1 per cent to Rs 2,782 crore from Rs 2,154.9 crore, while gross merchandise value rose 34 per cent to Rs 5,590 crore, with the fashion segment turning Ebitda-positive. The company also announced the acquisition of a 51 per cent stake in premium skincare brand Aminu Wellness for Rs 32 crore, strengthening its push into premium personal care, with the remaining stake to be acquired over the coming years. Investors will track the pace of its quick-commerce vertical, Nykaa Now, which has expanded to 13 cities and is set to scale beyond 25 by the end of FY27.

a.title: Nykaa acquires 51% stake in skincare brand Aminu for ₹32 crore
a.content:
ADVERTISEMENT
Beauty and fashion retailer Nykaa will acquire a 51% stake in Mumbai-based skincare brand Aminu for ₹32 crore through an all-cash transaction, according to a stock exchange filing.
Nykaa said Aminu operates in a high-growth segment of the beauty market and has emerged as one of the top premium skincare brands on its platform in the ₹1,000-₹1,900 price range. The brand sells products including serums and sleep oils.
Founded in 2019, Aminu is a bootstrapped skincare startup. The company reported revenue of ₹19.5 crore in FY26, up from ₹13 crore a year earlier, reflecting growing demand for premium skincare products in India.
According to Nykaa, spending in India's beauty and personal care market continues to be concentrated in the premium segment. The company said Aminu's positioning, research and development capabilities and omnichannel presence make it a good fit within its beauty portfolio.
The acquisition adds another brand to Nykaa's expanding stable of owned and partner-led beauty businesses. Under its House of Nykaa portfolio, the company already operates and invests in brands such as Kay Beauty, Dot & Key and Nykaa Cosmetics.
The deal announcement came alongside Nykaa's June-quarter earnings. Parent company FSN E-Commerce Ventures reported a net profit of ₹80 crore in Q1 FY27, compared with ₹24 crore a year earlier. Revenue from operations rose 29% year-on-year to ₹2,782 crore.
Nykaa's beauty business continued to be the company's key growth driver during the quarter. The beauty segment's net sales value grew 29% year-on-year, supported by growth across e-commerce, physical retail stores and owned brands.
The acquisition also reflects increased consolidation in India's beauty and skincare market, where larger platforms are investing in niche premium brands to strengthen product portfolios and deepen customer engagement. Premium skincare has been one of the fastest-growing categories in the sector, driven by higher consumer spending, social commerce and growing awareness around skincare routines.
According to reports, Nykaa may acquire the remaining stake in Aminu over the next few years, while the founders are expected to continue leading the business. The first phase of the transaction is expected to close during the September quarter.

a.content: Nykaa’s Stellar Q1 Nykaa fired on all cylinders in Q1. The quarter saw the beauty ecommerce giant clock a three-fold jump in profits, expand margins and increase its footprint. Meanwhile, its fashion business turned EBITDA positive for the first time. Here is a snapshot of Nykaa’s Q1 FY27 numbers: Net profit zoomed 3X YoY to ₹79.8 Cr Operating revenue rose 29% YoY to ₹2,782 Cr Total expenses also grew 26% YoY to ₹2,662 Cr EBITDA grew 68% YoY to ₹236 Cr, while EBITDA margin expanded to 8.5% The Beauty Upside: Powered by stronger engagement, improving margins, higher average order values and a premium portfolio, the beauty business remained Nykaa’s core engine. The vertical contributed 90% of its total revenue in Q1. The quarter also saw Nykaa Beauty deepen its omnichannel footprint to 324 stores, while onboarding global names to broaden choice. The Fashion Fiesta: Nykaa Fashion turned EBITDA positive for the first time on the back of stronger operating leverage. The business also managed to accelerate GMV and net sales on the back of a wider brand mix and sharper merchandising. Expansions into activewear, kidswear and footwear also helped Nykaa’s fashion arm move from a growth bet to a serious contender. The Q-Comm Mania: The quarter also saw Nykaa scale its quick commerce platform to 13 cities, with a target to cross 25 by end-FY27. While domestic consumption remained strong, Nykaa’s Gulf joint venture, Nysaa, continued to face pressures due to geopolitical tensions. This dampened overseas acceleration. The House Of Brands: Premiumisation push also remained high on the beauty giant’s agenda. Nykaa now plans to acquire a 51% stake in D2C skincare brand Aminu to fill the gap in its premium skincare portfolio and leverage the brand’s salon distribution. Together with earlier buys like Dot & Key and Earth Rhythm, Nykaa appears to be reinforcing its house of brands strategy across categories and price points. As the beauty ecommerce major finally marries scale with profitability, here is how Nykaa fared on the financial front in Q1… From The Editor’s Desk 🎓 Klassroom Wraps Up IPO The edtech platform’s public issue was oversubscribed 146% on the third and final day of bidding, receiving bids for 25.66 Lakh shares against 17.58 Lakh shares on offer. MapmyIndia derived the biggest chunk of its top line from enterprises, aided by new deployments across mobility, logistics, BFSI, manufacturing and telecom. Founded in 2022, Vaaree operates an online marketplace that offers more than 1.5 Lakh products across categories such as bedding, furnishings, kitchenware, bath products, and lighting. Prior to this round, it had raised over $6 Mn. The fundraise comes amid growing investor interest in the growing Indian D2C home decor ecosystem, which is seeing healthy traction on the back of rising disposable incomes, a massive real estate uptick and growing consumer aspirations. 🏦 Mintoak Acquires ICC Loyalty The fintech startup has acquired the UAE-based loyalty and rewards tech company for an undisclosed amount to foray into customer engagement and data monetisation. The deal was funded via Mintoak’s balance sheet and a small debt component. Founded in 2017, Mintoak helps financial institutions offer business management and payments tools to their SME merchant base. The startup works with over 50 banks across 20 countries and processes over $93 Bn in annual payment volume. Meanwhile, media giant Times Network has acquired fintech startup OpiGo for an undisclosed amount. The move is part of its business channel ET NOW’s expansion into investor-focused financial services. 🚀 Google Play Accelerator’s 2026 Cohort The big tech giant has picked 20 Indian startups for the 2026 cohort of its Google Play Accelerator India programme. The initiative offers support to selected ventures across AI integration, monetisation, security and growth. Octobotics wants to change this by sending crawler robots into these zones instead of humans. Bots To The Rescue: Founded in 2020, Octobotics builds inspection robots for oil and gas, railways and other asset-heavy sectors. Its core product is a magnetic crawler robot that sticks to steel surfaces and can crawl across tanks and pipes. The startup’s bots also use phased array ultrasonics to detect cracks and defects, mapping their location, size and depth. Octobotics is also pivoting to a service model, with plans to add a SaaS reporting layer and eventually rent robots to third-party vendors. a.title: Nykaa Acquires 51 Pc Stake in D2C Skincare Brand Aminu for Rs 32 Cr
a.content:
Beauty and personal care retailer Nykaa has approved the acquisition of a 51 percent stake in direct-to-consumer skincare brand Aminu for a cash consideration of up to Rs 32 crore, as part of its strategy to strengthen its premium skincare portfolio.
The transaction is expected to be completed by September 15, with Nykaa planning to acquire the remaining 49 percent stake over the next few years. The company said Aminu’s founders will continue to lead the business, while Nykaa will support its expansion and scaling efforts.
Founded in 2019 by Prachi Bhandari and Aman Mohunta, Aminu offers a portfolio of more than 60 skincare products, including serums, cleansers, sunscreens, moisturisers, face masks, and body care products. The brand also provides complimentary skin consultation services to its customers.
Nykaa said the acquisition aligns with its focus on expanding its presence in the premium skincare segment. During its post-earnings call, the company highlighted that Aminu’s products are positioned at higher price points than existing skincare brands within its House of Nykaa portfolio, helping bridge a gap in its premium offerings.
The acquisition is also expected to strengthen Nykaa’s in-house scientific skincare capabilities, with Aminu bringing more than 30 proprietary formulations backed by research and development. In addition, the company sees value in Aminu’s omnichannel presence, with products sold through its own website, marketplaces such as Nykaa and Clinikally, e-commerce platforms including Amazon and Zepto, and a network of around 180 salons across India.
The bootstrapped startup reported Rs 19.4 crore in revenue during FY26, reflecting nearly 50 percent year-on-year growth from approximately Rs 13 crore in FY25. According to its website, Aminu sources ingredients from more than 40 countries and uses over 250 ingredients across its product portfolio, while excluding nearly 3,000 commonly used ingredients to maintain clean skincare formulations.
The deal adds to Nykaa’s ongoing House of Brands strategy, under which it has previously acquired or invested in beauty brands such as Dot & Key and Earth Rhythm. The company currently manages seven beauty and personal care brands and five fashion brands, including its flagship Nykaa Cosmetics label. It also said it will continue expanding into categories such as premium fragrances, derma-led skincare, mid-premium nutraceuticals, and products for professional makeup artists.
Gaurs Group has sold out the entire available inventory of its newly launched premium residential project, Gaur Alaris, during a two-day allotment event held for homebuyers. Located in Sector 22D on the Yamuna Expressway near the upcoming Noida International Airport, the project offered 3 BHK and 4 BHK apartments and recorded strong demand shortly after bookings opened.
Launched in August 2026, Gaur Alaris is expected to generate sales realisation of approximately Rs 1,900 crore. The development follows the company's earlier luxury housing project, Gaur NYC Residences, which was sold out within 60 hours before its official launch.
The latest sell-out highlights growing demand for residential real estate along the Yamuna Expressway corridor, which has witnessed increased buyer interest due to infrastructure development, improved connectivity, and the upcoming Noida International Airport. The region has emerged as a key destination for both end-users and property investors.
Manoj Gaur, CMD, Gaurs Group said, “The response to Gaur Alaris is a strong endorsement of the evolving potential of the Yamuna Expressway as a residential destination. The complete sell-out reflects the confidence buyers have in the corridor as well as in the quality, planning and execution that Gaurs Group brings to its developments. It is also a testament to the trust and belief our customers have in us, the legacy that has been built over 3 decades by timely delivery of all our projects.”
The project has been designed around a peacock-inspired concept and features Art Deco architecture by Hafeez Contractor. Landscape planning has been undertaken by Site Concepts International, while interior design has been developed by Studio Designscape. Gaur Alaris includes a clubhouse spread across more than 1 lakh sq ft, nearly eight acres of landscaped open spaces, and over 65 amenities across the residential development.
Sarthak Gaur, Director, Gaursons India Pvt Ltd said, “The Allotment Day of Gaur Alaris was a big success and is an endorsement of the trust of our buyers and the credibility of Gaurs Group. The complete sell-out of Gaur Alaris reflects the strong momentum that the Yamuna Expressway is currently witnessing. The Noida International Airport has added a significant new dimension to the region, while the overall infrastructure ecosystem continues to improve. Also, to our advantage, we already had a strong footprint in this region as we have already delivered a 250-acre integrated township – Gaur Yamuna City on Yamuna Expressway which is today home to almost 15000 residents.”
The project adds to Gaurs Group's premium and luxury housing portfolio, which includes developments such as The Islands by Gaurs, Legacy by Gaurs, Trecento Residences by Gaurs, Gaur NYC Residences, and Gaur Chrysalis. The company said it plans to launch two additional residential projects on the Yamuna Expressway in the near future as demand in the region continues to grow.
Nykaa reported strong growth across its beauty and fashion businesses for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, supported by store expansion, customer acquisition, omnichannel growth, and brand additions. The beauty and lifestyle retailer said its Beauty vertical is expected to record net sales value (NSV) growth and net revenue growth in the late twenties on a year-on-year basis during the second quarter.
The performance was driven by continued omnichannel expansion, growth in new customers, higher repeat purchases, and improved offline retail performance. Nykaa's physical retail business also recorded like-for-like (LFL) store sales growth in the early twenties, marking the highest LFL growth rate for its store network in the last six quarters.
As part of its retail expansion strategy, Nykaa added 14 net new stores during the quarter, taking its total offline store count to 338 as of September 30, 2026. The expansion further strengthens the company's omnichannel retail presence across India's beauty and personal care market.
The company's owned brand portfolio, House of Nykaa, continued to outperform the broader Beauty business during the quarter. Growth was supported by established brands within the portfolio as well as emerging beauty labels across skincare, cosmetics, and personal care categories. Nykaa's Fashion business also maintained strong momentum as it continued to scale operations. The company expects Fashion NSV growth in the late forties and net revenue growth in the early forties year-on-year, increasing the segment's contribution to overall revenue.
Product assortment expansion remained a key focus area during the quarter. Across its beauty and fashion platforms, Nykaa onboarded more than 250 brands in Q2 FY27, broadening consumer choice across categories. The company also reported early consumer interest following its exclusive partnership with Nike, which was announced during the period.
Nykaa noted that the timing of India's festive season affected quarterly demand patterns. A significant share of festive shopping activity shifted into the third quarter of FY27 rather than the September quarter. As a result, the company expects the December quarter to witness the bulk of festive demand and sales volumes. Despite the timing shift, Nykaa said its long-term growth drivers across beauty retail, fashion e-commerce, omnichannel retail, and owned brands remain unchanged.
The update highlights continued momentum in India's beauty retail and fashion retail sectors, with store expansion, premium brand partnerships, and omnichannel growth supporting Nykaa's business performance.
Ahead of the festive season, Amazon India has announced the expansion of its Ashray network with 50 new centres across the country, taking the total number of operational centres to 200. The company said it remains on track to reach 250 Ashray centres by the end of 2026 as it continues to strengthen support infrastructure for delivery drivers.
Amazon India also expanded its mobile Ashray van initiative to Bengaluru, making it the fourth city after Delhi NCR, Mumbai, and Hyderabad to receive the service. Two mobile Ashray vans were flagged off in Bengaluru in the presence of Sandy Gordon, Vice President, Employee Experience and Relations, Amazon, and Brendan Branon, Vice President of North America (NA) Employee Relations (ER).
The move comes ahead of the festive shopping season, a period that typically sees a significant rise in e-commerce orders and last-mile deliveries across India.
Salim R. Memon, Director – Operations, Amazon India said, "With the festive season driving a sharp increase in deliveries, it's more important than ever that drivers across the industry have access to rest on their routes. Ashray was built on a simple idea — that every delivery driver, whether they deliver for Amazon or not, deserves a clean, cool place to rest during their workday. Expanding to 200 centres and bringing mobile vans to more cities means we can reach more drivers in more cities, right when they need it most. This expansion is part of Amazon India's broader investment of over INR 2,800 crore (~USD 300 million) in 2026 to strengthen associate safety, health, and financial well-being across its operations network."
Launched in 2024, the Ashray initiative has grown into one of India's largest delivery driver welfare programmes. The centres are open to all delivery drivers, including those not associated with Amazon. The facilities provide air-conditioned seating, drinking water, mobile charging points, clean washrooms, first-aid support, and designated rest areas. Each centre can accommodate 10 to 15 people at a time and allows free access for up to 30 minutes per visit. The centres operate throughout the year from 9 a.m. to 7 p.m. and are located at high-footfall areas such as petrol pumps and commercial hubs. Their locations are also listed on Google Maps to improve accessibility.
To complement the fixed centres, Amazon's mobile Ashray vans provide similar amenities directly on high-density delivery routes. The fully air-conditioned vans offer seating, drinking water, free Wi-Fi connectivity, and mobile charging facilities, allowing delivery personnel to take short breaks during work hours.
Ashray Expansion Timeline
- 2024: Pilot launched with Ashray centres across Delhi NCR, Bengaluru, and Mumbai.
- 2025: Expanded to 100 centres across 16 cities.
- May 2026: Added 50 new centres, taking the total to 150; mobile Ashray vans launched in Delhi NCR.
- September 2026: Announced 50 additional centres, increasing the total to 200; mobile Ashray vans now operational in Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Hyderabad, and Bengaluru.
- End of 2026 Target: 250 Ashray centres across India.
The latest expansion is part of Amazon India's broader investment in delivery associate welfare, logistics infrastructure, and last-mile operations as e-commerce demand continues to grow across the country.
Canon India plans to expand its consumer printing retail network to more than 10,000 active retailers across 700 cities by the end of 2027, doubling its current reach as it looks to deepen its presence in Tier II, Tier III and Tier IV markets. The expansion follows sustained double-digit year-on-year growth in Canon India’s Consumer Printing business. The company is looking to improve access to printing products and services while growing its presence across consumer, SME, education, enterprise and institutional segments in India.
Demand for printing solutions is evolving across homes, schools, small businesses and enterprises, particularly in smaller cities where entrepreneurship, digital adoption and education-related requirements are increasing. Canon aims to use its wider retail network to improve product availability, strengthen local distribution and provide customers with access to product consultation and after-sales support.
The company is also investing in product development, digital commerce and partner capabilities as part of its wider India growth strategy. Building on the Canon Passport Program, which supports more than 5,000 active reseller partners through a digital rewards and engagement platform, Canon India is introducing BizBee for its B2B partner network.
BizBee will cater to System Integrators, Value-Added Resellers and other partners by providing access to incentives, product and solution training, technical certifications, business resources and digital tools. The initiative is intended to strengthen Canon’s B2B channel ecosystem across enterprise, education and institutional markets.
Toshiaki Nomura, President and CEO, Canon India said, “India is central to Canon’s long-term growth ambitions, underpinned by the resilience of its economy and the emergence of new centres of enterprise and consumption. As education, digitisation and infrastructure reshape demand across Tier lll and Tier IV markets, we see a significant opportunity to unlock the next phase of growth for our printing business. Our ambition to build a network of over 10,000 active retailers across 700 cities by 2027 reflects our commitment to invest ahead of the curve and bring Canon closer to customers through trusted touchpoints that combine first-hand product experience with expert guidance. By combining scale with customer-led innovation and strong channel partnerships, we are positioning Canon to lead and shape the future of printing in India.”
To support the expansion, Canon India is strengthening its omnichannel distribution network across traditional resellers, large-format retail chains, e-commerce, quick commerce and enterprise-focused partners. The company currently operates more than 400 active PIXMA Zones across India and plans to add over 500 PIXMA Zone Lite stores this year. Its Canon eSHOP platform also allows authorised resellers to showcase and sell Canon products digitally.
The wider channel strategy is aimed at giving customers flexibility to research and purchase products across online and offline retail formats while enabling Canon to extend its presence beyond major metropolitan markets. Canon is also increasing investment in retailer engagement and frontline sales capabilities. Its Retail Display Incentive Program currently covers over 1,000 partners and focuses on strengthening product visibility at physical retail outlets.
At the same time, the company plans to scale its RetailChamp Initiative from 400 to more than 1,000 retail sales personnel. The programme focuses on improving product knowledge and customer consultation across the company's retail network. Beyond consumer retail, Canon India intends to expand its System Integrator network to more than 500 partners nationwide. The move is expected to increase its reach across enterprise, education and government segments.
C Sukumaran, Vice President, Canon India said, “Our channel ecosystem will be central to translating Canon’s growth ambition into business impact. As we expand our reach, our focus is on building the capabilities of our partners and frontline teams to understand local needs, create demand and deliver trusted customer experience. Through initiatives such as Canon Passport, RetailChamp and BizBee, we are strengthening partner engagement, knowledge and enablement across the ecosystem. BizBee, in particular, will equip our B2B partners and System Integrators with the training, certifications and business tools needed to unlock opportunities across enterprise, education and government segments. Together, these efforts will help us build a more capable partner network and drive solution-led growth across consumer, SME and institutional markets.”
Canon’s expansion strategy brings together physical retail, digital commerce, reseller engagement and B2B channel development as the company increases its reach across India. The planned addition of retailers, PIXMA Zone Lite stores, System Integrators and trained frontline personnel is expected to support Canon’s consumer printing business across smaller cities while strengthening its ability to serve education, SME, enterprise and institutional customers.
Carlsberg India has received approval from the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) for its confidential pre-filing of documents for a proposed initial public offering (IPO). The company had submitted its draft IPO papers to SEBI through the confidential route in July 2026. This process allows companies to keep their draft offer documents private during the initial review, before deciding when to make the filing public.
The approval marks a key milestone in Carlsberg India’s proposed initial public offering (IPO). Details regarding the issue size, timeline, and other terms are expected to be disclosed in the offer documents, subject to the necessary regulatory and corporate approvals.
The proposed listing comes amid growing interest among multinational companies in India’s equity markets, as businesses look to unlock value from their investments in the country. The potential IPO would add to the activity in India’s primary market, with anticipated offerings from companies such as Jio Platforms drawing investor attention.
Carlsberg India commenced commercial operations in June 2007 with the launch of Carlsberg Green, entering India’s premium beer segment. Since then, the company has expanded its presence in the domestic beer market through a portfolio of brands, including Carlsberg and Tuborg.
The parent company has also reported positive volume growth across key markets. In its earnings guidance for the six months ended June 30, 2026, Danish brewer Carlsberg reported overall volume growth of 2.8%, while organic volume growth stood at 1.7%. Europe recorded volume growth of 0.1%, while the Central and Eastern Europe and India region registered growth of 6.2%.
The performance highlights the contribution of the Central and Eastern Europe and India region to the group's volume growth during the first half of 2026. With SEBI approval secured, Carlsberg India has taken another step toward its proposed public listing, with further details expected to emerge following the release of the relevant offer documents.
Global apparel retailer UNIQLO has reopened its expanded store at Ambience Mall, Gurugram, strengthening its retail presence in North India and offering customers a larger shopping destination featuring the brand’s latest seasonal collections and customer engagement initiatives.
The reopening was marked by a traditional Taiko drum performance, creating a festive atmosphere that attracted a large number of shoppers to the store. Customers visiting the revamped outlet were introduced to the expanded retail space and a wider assortment of products across key categories.
The enlarged store features UNIQLO’s latest Fall/Winter collection, including seasonal essentials such as Fleece, Knitwear, HEATTECH and PUFFTECH. The expansion is aimed at improving the overall shopping experience while providing consumers with greater access to the brand’s apparel and technology-driven clothing solutions.
In addition to the product showcase, UNIQLO introduced a series of customer-focused experiences designed to encourage participation and community engagement. One of the highlights was the UNIQLO Share Wall, an interactive installation where visitors could share personal stories and experiences about what they appreciate most about the brand.
The company also promoted sustainability through its RE: UNIQLO initiative. A dedicated donation box was installed at the store, encouraging customers to contribute pre-loved clothing that can be redirected to individuals and communities in need. The initiative forms part of UNIQLO’s broader efforts to support responsible consumption and extend the lifecycle of garments.
To celebrate the reopening, UNIQLO has announced a range of special promotional offers, available from October 2 to October 8. The limited-period deals are intended to drive footfall to the newly expanded outlet while giving customers an opportunity to explore the retailer’s latest collections and in-store experiences.
The Ambience Mall store expansion reflects UNIQLO’s continued focus on strengthening its retail footprint in India. By combining a larger retail format, seasonal product innovations, and community-driven initiatives, the brand aims to deepen its engagement with consumers while reinforcing its position in the country’s growing fashion and apparel market.
Reliance-backed online healthcare platform Netmeds reported steady financial performance for FY26, maintaining profitability despite recording only moderate growth in revenue.
Revenue from operations increased 2.3 percent to Rs 44.7 crore in FY26, compared to Rs 43.7 crore in FY25. The digital healthcare and online pharmacy platform posted a profit of Rs 5.5 crore during the fiscal year, continuing its profitable run despite a relatively stable topline.
Netmeds operates across multiple healthcare segments, including online pharmacy, diagnostics, teleconsultation services, and healthcare product sales. In addition to product transactions, the company derives income from healthcare-related services and marketing activities.
Services remained the primary contributor to the company’s business during the year. Gross service income stood at Rs 46.3 crore, largely unchanged from Rs 46.2 crore reported in the previous fiscal. Revenue generated from the sale of goods, however, registered stronger growth, rising 24 percent to Rs 6.03 crore from Rs 4.86 crore in FY25.
Netmeds reported operating revenue of Rs 44.7 crore. The company also earned Rs 3.24 crore from non-operating income, taking its total income to Rs 47.94 crore for FY26.
The company significantly increased spending on brand visibility and customer outreach initiatives during the year. Advertising and promotional expenses jumped 76 percent to Rs 2.9 crore, compared to Rs 1.65 crore in FY25. Additional overhead expenses, including legal, professional, and rental costs, amounted to Rs 12.24 crore.
Overall expenditure increased to Rs 42.4 crore from Rs 41.6 crore in the previous fiscal year. Despite the rise in costs, Netmeds remained in the black, although its profit declined by around 5 percent year-on-year.
The company reported a return on capital employed (ROCE) of 4.5 percent and an EBITDA margin of 5.66 percent. Operational efficiency remained largely stable, with Netmeds spending approximately Rs 0.95 to generate every Re 1 of operating revenue, in line with FY25 levels.
Reliance Industries, through Reliance Retail Ventures Ltd. (RRVL), acquired a majority stake in Netmeds for approximately Rs 620 crore in August 2020 as part of its expansion into the digital healthcare and e-pharmacy sector.
Netmeds competes with major players in India’s online healthcare market, including Tata 1mg, PharmEasy and Apollo 24/7. During FY26, Tata 1mg reported Rs 2,936 crore in revenue while posting a consolidated loss of Rs 287 crore, whereas API Holdings, the parent company of PharmEasy, reported Rs 6,869 crore in revenue.
Cinema exhibitor Cinépolis India has strengthened its presence in Haryana with the launch of a new four-screen multiplex at Amolik’s City Life Mall in Sector 28, Faridabad.
With the latest opening, the company has doubled its footprint in the city to eight screens, less than a year after inaugurating its first Faridabad property at Pacific Mall.
The newly launched multiplex houses 549 seats across four screens and offers recliner seating, Dolby sound technology and the brand’s food and beverage services. The opening comes ahead of the Gandhi Jayanti holiday weekend and the release of Drishyam: The Conclusion on October 2.
The expansion is part of Cinépolis India’s broader growth strategy across the Delhi-NCR cinema market. In recent months, the multiplex chain has added new properties at IREO Grand High Street in Gurugram and Dwarka, taking its regional network to 16 cinemas and 78 screens.
Devang Sampat, Managing Director, Cinépolis India said, "For us, growth is really a catchment question. Sector 28, has settled residential neighbourhoods on every side, and Faridabad is a big city, so there's room here for more than one Cinépolis. The choice of mall matters just as much. Amolik has built City Life as a place where families already come to eat and shop, and a good cinema gives them one more reason to spend the evening there. When a cinema runs well, the businesses around it do well too."
Located in the residential hub of Sector 28, City Life Mall has been developed by Amolik, whose portfolio in Faridabad also includes projects such as Amolik Heights and Amolik Residency.
Canon India has announced plans to expand its consumer printing distribution network to more than 10,000 active retailers across 700 cities by the end of 2027, doubling its current reach as the company looks to capitalize on growing demand for printing solutions across India.
The expansion comes amid sustained double-digit growth in Canon’s consumer printing business and is aimed at increasing product accessibility across Tier II, III, and IV markets. The company expects the initiative to support growth across consumer, SME, education, enterprise, and institutional segments.
Through its planned expansion across 700 cities, the company aims to improve product availability, enhance brand visibility, and provide greater access to consultation and after-sales support.
Toshiaki Nomura, President & CEO, Canon India, said, “India is central to Canon’s long-term growth ambitions, underpinned by the resilience of its economy and the emergence of new centres of enterprise and consumption. As education, digitisation and infrastructure reshape demand across Tier 3 and Tier 4 markets, we see a significant opportunity to unlock the next phase of growth for our printing business. Our ambition to build a network of over 10,000 active retailers across 700 cities by 2027 reflects our commitment to invest ahead of the curve and bring Canon closer to customers through trusted touchpoints that combine first-hand product experience with expert guidance. By combining scale with customer-led innovation and strong channel partnerships, we are positioning Canon to lead and shape the future of printing in India.”
To support the expansion, Canon is enhancing its omnichannel strategy across traditional retail, large-format stores, e-commerce, quick commerce, and enterprise-focused channels. The company currently operates more than 400 PIXMA Zones nationwide and plans to add over 500 PIXMA Zone Lite stores this year. Its Canon eSHOP platform also enables authorized resellers to showcase and sell products digitally.
Canon is further strengthening its partner ecosystem through initiatives such as the Canon Passport Program, which supports more than 5,000 reseller partners, and the newly launched BizBee platform for system integrators and value-added resellers. BizBee will provide partners with training, certifications, incentives, and business tools to enhance solution-led selling.
The company is also investing in retail engagement programs, including the Retail Display Incentive Program and RetailChamp Initiative, which is being expanded from 400 to over 1,000 retail sales personnel to improve product expertise and customer support.
Milky Mist Dairy Food Limited has commissioned a new 10 MW solar power plant at Arasanoor, further strengthening its renewable energy infrastructure and sustainability initiatives. The latest addition comes alongside the 15 MW solar facility already operational at the same location, taking the company’s total investment in the 25 MW Arasanoor solar project to Rs 109.60 crore.
With the commissioning of the new facility, Milky Mist’s renewable energy portfolio has grown to 41 MW. The company’s renewable assets now include 5 MW at Chithode, 9 MW at Kavilipalayam, 25 MW at Arasanoor, and 2 MW of wind power at Kayathar. According to the company, renewable energy sources now meet its entire power requirement across operations.
The solar installations have been developed on arid and open land that is not suitable for agricultural use, allowing the company to utilize such areas for renewable energy generation while supporting its sustainability goals.
The newly operational 25 MW solar facility is expected to generate around 20 million units of renewable electricity annually and supply power to Milky Mist’s integrated manufacturing facility in Perundurai as well as its milk chilling centers. The additional capacity is also projected to reduce dependence on conventional energy sources and help avoid nearly 16,000 tonnes of carbon emissions every year.
Beyond solar and wind energy, the company has invested in steam turbine technology and a methane gas purification plant that generates approximately 15,000 units of electricity daily. Methane produced through effluent treatment processes is purified and converted into compressed natural gas (CNG), while biomass is also used in boiler operations to further reduce reliance on conventional energy sources.
T Sathish Kumar, Chairman and Managing Director, Milky Mist Dairy Food Limited said, “At Milky Mist, our approach to growth has always been guided by a long-term vision of building a business that is responsible in its use of resources and conscious of its impact on the environment. We believe that sustainability must be embedded in the way an enterprise is built, operated and scaled, rather than viewed as a standalone initiative. Our investments in renewable energy, resource-efficient technologies and alternative sources of power are a reflection of this philosophy. The commissioning of our new 10 MW solar power plant is another significant step in this journey, taking renewable sources to over 90% of our total power requirements. As we continue to expand our operations, our endeavour is to strengthen energy self-sufficiency, advance more sustainable manufacturing practices and create enduring value for our business, our stakeholders and the environment.”
The latest investment aligns with Milky Mist’s broader strategy of building a technology-driven and resource-efficient manufacturing ecosystem, while continuing to explore opportunities to enhance energy efficiency and expand the use of renewable power across its operations.
Amazon India has expanded its ultra-fast delivery service, Amazon Now, to more than 120 cities across the country, doubling the service’s reach within two weeks. The expansion brings the quick-commerce offering to several new markets, including Amritsar, Abohar, Jalandhar, Ambala, Mangalore, Manipal, Visakhapatnam, Kochi, Changanassery, Bhubaneswar, and Karwar.
Amazon Now enables customers to receive deliveries within minutes and offers access to a broad assortment of daily essentials. The service covers categories such as groceries, including fresh fruits and vegetables, frozen foods, personal care products, beauty items, fashion, small appliances, home essentials, and kitchen products.
To support the growing network, Amazon is leveraging nearly 800 micro-fulfilment and urban fulfilment centres across India. The infrastructure is designed to facilitate rapid deliveries while expanding product availability in both metropolitan and emerging markets.
Harsh Goyal, Vice President – Everyday Essentials, Amazon India said, "We are delighted to take ultra-fast deliveries with Amazon Now to India’s hinterland – from Amritsar & Abohar in the north to Kochi & Changanassery in the south – ahead of the Amazon Great Indian Festival. Amazon Now continues to be the fastest-growing ecommerce business unit in Amazon India's history with orders doubling every quarter. This accelerated rollout underscores our commitment to making fast & reliable delivery accessible to customers across the country. We look forward to continue scaling up and offering the widest selection of products at the fastest delivery speeds this festive season.”
The announcement follows Amazon’s recent disclosure that Amazon Now achieved an annualized gross sales run rate of $1 billion in India over the past three-month period. The company plans to further scale the service to more than 300 cities as it works toward building one of the country’s largest delivery-in-minutes networks.
Ahead of the Amazon Great Indian Festival, which begins on October 8, customers using Amazon Now will have access to deals across multiple product categories. Amazon will also offer a 10 percent instant discount on SBI Credit Cards, Debit Cards, and EMI transactions, while Prime members will be eligible for additional savings on select purchases.
Acerpure India, a part of the Acer Group, has introduced its new Nitro QLED TV range in India. The smart TV lineup is now available on Flipkart and includes 75-inch, 85-inch, and 100-inch screen variants, targeting consumers seeking large-screen home entertainment and gaming experiences.
The new Nitro QLED TVs combine QLED display technology with a 120Hz HSR refresh rate, aimed at delivering smoother visuals for gaming, sports broadcasts, and high-motion content. The televisions also support Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos, offering enhanced picture quality and audio performance. The range runs on Google TV 5.0 Ref+, providing access to streaming platforms, smart TV features, and connected entertainment services.
In terms of audio, the 75-inch and 85-inch models come equipped with 40W box speakers, while the 100-inch variant features a 65W box speaker system. The televisions also include a built-in karaoke feature, expanding their entertainment offering for family and group viewing.
Vasudeva G, Director, Acerpure India said, “The way consumers experience entertainment at home is evolving rapidly, and we see a growing desire for experiences that are not just bigger, but genuinely more immersive and engaging. With Nitro, we are bringing the scale of the big screen into the living room and creating a proposition that is as much about the experience as it is about the technology behind it. The 75-inch, 85-inch, and 100-inch formats reflect our ambition to make larger-than-life entertainment more accessible to Indian consumers. Our association with Akshay Kumar as the brand ambassador for Acerpure further strengthens this vision of connecting technology with contemporary lifestyles and entertainment. Through our partnership with Flipkart, we are excited to take this proposition to consumers across the country.”
The launch comes as demand for premium smart TVs, large-screen displays, connected home entertainment devices, and gaming-focused televisions continues to grow in India. With larger display options and advanced audio-visual features, Acerpure is expanding its presence in the consumer electronics and smart TV market. The Acerpure Nitro QLED TV range is available on Flipkart, with prices starting at Rs 59,999.
ICA-GemLab, an international organisation specialising in diamonds, coloured gemstones, and jewellery testing, is set to open its first laboratory in India this October. The new facility will be located in Surat, Gujarat, a major global hub for diamond processing, jewellery manufacturing, and gemstone trade. The laboratory will offer testing, certification, and reporting services for diamonds, coloured gemstones, and jewellery, providing manufacturers, traders, retailers, jewellery brands, and consumers with access to gemological analysis within India.
The Surat facility marks ICA-GemLab’s first laboratory in the Indian subcontinent and forms part of the organisation’s expansion strategy to strengthen its presence in key global gems and jewellery sourcing markets. The laboratory will operate in coordination with ICA-GemLab’s headquarters in Bangkok and its existing offices in Dubai and Hong Kong.
As one of the world's leading centres for diamond cutting, polishing, and jewellery production, Surat plays a critical role in the global gems and jewellery supply chain. The new laboratory aims to provide testing and reporting services closer to the manufacturing and trading stages before products enter retail channels. ICA-GemLab is affiliated with the International Colored Gemstone Association (ICA), a global trade body representing the coloured gemstone industry. The Surat laboratory will follow the reporting standards, analytical procedures, and professional practices adopted across the ICA-GemLab network.
Kalpesh Desai, who will lead ICA-GemLab India as Director said, “India has a significant share of the world’s diamond processing, with Surat being one of its key centres. Our aim is to provide direct access to our internationally established analytical methods and reporting standards to manufacturers, traders, retailers, designers and consumers. We are working with a long-term plan. We aim to provide reliable gemological information, documented methodologies and analysis that can help traders and consumers make decisions based on appropriate information.”
Amira Hatta, Managing Director, ICA-GemLab Global said, “India is one of the most important markets in the global gems and jewellery industry. Opening a laboratory in Surat will bring our analytical capabilities directly to this market, so that customers will have access to our services closer to where they operate.”
The laboratory will issue three categories of reports: Diamond Reports, Coloured Gemstone Reports, and Jewellery Reports. These services will cater to jewellery manufacturers, wholesalers, gemstone traders, retailers, jewellery designers, industry professionals, and end consumers.
Headquartered in Bangkok, ICA-GemLab currently operates offices in Dubai and Hong Kong. The organisation also works with Sri Lanka’s National Gem and Jewellery Authority to provide gem testing services in the country. The launch of the Surat laboratory represents the latest step in its international expansion within the gems, diamonds, and jewellery certification sector.
ITC Ltd has acquired the remaining 52.5 percent stake in Sproutlife Foods Private Ltd for approximately Rs 645 crore, taking full ownership of the health foods company and making it a wholly owned subsidiary. According to a regulatory filing, the FMCG major purchased 13,445 equity shares of Sproutlife Foods through a secondary cash transaction. Following the acquisition, ITC's shareholding in the company has increased from around 47.5 percent to 100 percent.
The transaction was completed on September 28, and Sproutlife Foods became a wholly owned subsidiary of ITC with effect from the same date. The company stated that no regulatory approvals were required for the acquisition. The move is aligned with ITC's strategy to strengthen its presence in the packaged foods, health foods, nutrition products, and FMCG segments while expanding its future-ready food portfolio.
Sproutlife Foods owns and markets products under the Yoga Bar brand, which operates in the healthy snacks, breakfast cereals, protein products, and nutrition-focused food categories. Founded in February 2015, the company has reported steady growth over the past three financial years.
The company recorded a turnover of Rs 452 crore in FY2025-26, up from Rs 200 crore in FY2024-25 and Rs 108 crore in FY2023-24, reflecting strong growth in India's health and wellness food market. The acquisition further strengthens ITC's position in the fast-growing health foods and packaged nutrition category, where consumer demand for better-for-you food products continues to rise.
Pepperfry has entered into a strategic partnership with Imaginest, a home interiors and modular solutions company promoted by the founders of Capstone Life, to strengthen its presence in the modular furniture and home interiors segment. The collaboration will combine Imaginest's design, manufacturing, and project execution capabilities with Pepperfry's omnichannel retail network, consumer reach, and home category expertise. The companies aim to offer customers an integrated experience covering design, customization, manufacturing, delivery, installation, and after-sales support.
The partnership is intended to simplify the home interiors journey by addressing common challenges such as dealing with multiple vendors, pricing transparency, and project execution timelines. Through the association, customers will be able to access modular home solutions through selected Pepperfry store locations.
Umesh Sangurmath, Founder, Capstone Life said, "The home interiors journey continues to be fragmented, particularly as customers look for reliable partners who can manage the journey from design to execution. Imaginest was created to bring thoughtful design and quality execution together. Our partnership with Pepperfry allows us to bring this proposition to customers in key markets, combining our capabilities with Pepperfry’s strong consumer presence and making the process of creating a home simpler and more predictable."
Balavender Singh, CEO, Imaginest added, "Our partnership with Pepperfry is about creating a better modular home experience for customers in major markets. By combining Imaginest’s design and execution capabilities with Pepperfry’s consumer connect and Store ecosystem, we can bring greater transparency, accountability and speed to the journey from the first design conversation through to installation and after-sales support. Together, we see an opportunity to build a differentiated modular proposition in the markets that matter most to today’s urban homeowner."
Ashish Shah, Co-Founder and CEO, Pepperfry said, "Modular furniture and home interiors are important growth areas for Pepperfry. Partnering with Imaginest strengthens our design and execution capabilities and enables us to deliver a more integrated modular experience to customers in key markets. Together, we aim to combine greater choice and transparent pricing with dependable execution and long-term product support."
The rollout will initially cover selected Pepperfry stores in major cities and key markets, with plans to expand the partnership's footprint over time. The collaboration comes as demand for modular kitchens, wardrobes, storage solutions, and customized home interiors continues to grow in India's home improvement and furniture retail market. Industry players are increasingly focusing on end-to-end solutions that combine design expertise, execution capabilities, and omnichannel customer engagement.
Flipkart has announced a major expansion of its supply chain and logistics infrastructure ahead of The Big Billion Days and the upcoming festive shopping season. Through its logistics arm Ekart, the company has added 14 million cubic feet of warehousing space across India, increasing its storage capacity by 50 percent. The e-commerce company said technology and automation upgrades have also increased peak processing capacity by more than 30 percent, enabling faster order fulfilment and delivery during the high-demand festive period.
To strengthen last-mile delivery capabilities, Ekart has added more than 900 delivery hubs across the country. The expansion is aimed at increasing same-day and next-day deliveries as online shopping demand rises during the festive season. With these additions, Ekart's network now includes more than 8,200 facilities, comprising fulfilment centres, sortation hubs, and last-mile delivery operations. The company also operates nearly 1,200 Flipkart Minutes micro-fulfilment centres across more than 150 cities.
As part of its efforts to support MSMEs, small businesses, artisans, weavers, and marketplace sellers, Flipkart has pre-positioned more than 2.5 crore product units in Ekart fulfilment centres ahead of the festive sale. The company has also opened 70 additional pick-up stations in key seller clusters to reduce fulfilment timelines and improve inventory movement.
Ekart's third-party logistics (3PL) franchise network has grown to 600 locations within two months of launch, enabling businesses beyond the Flipkart marketplace to access logistics and delivery services during the festive season. The company has also expanded its delivery footprint by adding more than 750 new PIN codes. The expansion includes regions such as Leh in Ladakh, Kargil in Jammu and Kashmir, parts of Rajasthan and Madhya Pradesh, and several locations across the Northeast, including Kamalanagar and Zamuang in Mizoram, Turacity, Resubelpara and Rajabala in Meghalaya, and Bomdila and Tezu in Arunachal Pradesh.
Hemant Badri, Senior Vice President and Head, Supply Chain, Flipkart Group said, "Every year, The Big Billion Days raises the bar for what customers expect: faster deliveries and wider reach. This year, a customer in Leh or Kargil will experience Big Billion Days for the first time. Across Ekart and Flipkart Minutes, we now operate over 8,200 facilities, allowing us to take the festive experience to more customers while helping sellers reach buyers they could not reach before."
To support increased operational demand, Flipkart has announced the creation of more than 2.5 lakh direct and indirect employment opportunities during the festive season. Of these, nearly 75,000 roles are expected to be filled by first-time workforce entrants. Around 60 percent of the new opportunities will be focused on last-mile delivery operations, reflecting the company's emphasis on faster deliveries and the continued expansion of Flipkart Minutes across Tier ll and Tier lll cities.
The company also highlighted measures for delivery personnel, known as Wishmasters. These include term life insurance, personal accident coverage, mediclaim benefits, access to a Doctor on Call service, festive-season bonuses, referral incentives, and AI-enabled onboarding through the Flipkart Delivery Partners app. The expansion underscores Flipkart's focus on strengthening its e-commerce logistics network, supply chain capabilities, seller ecosystem, and quick commerce operations ahead of one of India's largest online shopping events.
The Adie Broswon Group has entered the whisky segment with the launch of Kingpin Whisky, expanding its spirits portfolio across Delhi, Punjab and Chandigarh. The launch comes as India’s whisky market continues to record growth, with brands increasingly catering to consumers across different price points and consumption occasions.
According to IWSR data cited by the company, India recorded 4 percent growth in beverage alcohol volumes in 2025, while Indian whisky volumes also increased by 4 percent during the year. Against this backdrop, Kingpin has been introduced with a focus on combining a distinctive whisky profile with accessible pricing.
Kingpin is made using a blend of malts and Indian grain spirits. The product is designed to combine the character of malt whisky with the smoothness and versatility associated with grain spirits.
The whisky undergoes maturation and filtration, with the resulting profile featuring smoky notes alongside hints of tobacco and honey. The company said the product has been developed to offer a balanced drinking experience while retaining a pronounced character.
The brand is positioned around the philosophy “Live Bold. Drink Bold.” Its packaging uses a royal blue and gold colour scheme, with a crown-inspired insignia forming part of the visual identity.
Kingpin is being introduced in seven pack sizes: 1,000 ml, 750 ml, 500 ml, 375 ml, 180 ml, 90 ml and 60 ml. The range is intended to address different consumption occasions and price points across its initial markets.
The 750 ml bottle is priced at Rs 500 in Delhi, Rs 530 in Chandigarh and Rs 750 in Punjab. The varied pricing reflects differences across state markets, where alcoholic beverage taxation and pricing structures can vary.
The launch is part of the Adie Broswon Group’s broader focus on developing its own alcoholic beverage brands alongside its existing brewing and distillation operations.
Headquartered in Delhi NCR, the Group has interests across sugar, brewing, distillation and renewable energy. Its integrated 170-acre agro-industrial complex in Kiri Afgana, Batala, includes a sugar mill, three distilleries and a brewery.
